title_translated: 联合还是逐项？从1700万到10亿参数的封闭集决策紧凑编码器
summary_translated: 许多语言模型流水线最终会做出封闭集决策，如工具选择。使用大语言模型进行此类决策速度慢且对顺序敏感。我们探讨此类决策的编码器可以有多小，以及应联合读取选项还是分别读取。在3200万参数的三重种子研究中，逐项评分在保留样本的37个基准决策套件上，于匹配优化器步数时比联合评分高出5.8点机会校正技能，于近似匹配训练计算量时高出2.8点；两个外部基准也支持该结果，尽管在未见任务上未达显著水平。交叉阅读器与初始化方式发现，该优势需要一个重排序器初始化，其输入格式与逐项读取匹配；从原始编码器来看，两种阅读器无法区分。逐项评分需要5至13倍更多的编码器遍历次数：最多两次中位延迟，但平均延迟超过四倍。在六个发布的联合编码器（1700万至10亿参数）中，6800万和1500万参数模型在209个经过审计的System1-Arena任务上分别比4.35亿参数的DeBERTa-v3零样本分类器高出4.9和5.9个百分点，且在训练中未见过的145个任务上至少保持同等水平。最小的编码器在16个处理器线程上以14毫秒完成中位请求，而分类器为728毫秒。重新排列选项会使联合模型的答案改变12%至23%（逐项评分：无变化）。在最多6800万参数范围内，它们在公开排行榜的私有、主要分布内测试中领先。

summary: Language models (LMs) often exhibit successful cross-lingual transfer through continued (pre)training, still their underlying process remains unclear. One possibility is that LMs can leverage the evidence toward language-universal principles, namely, hierarchical structure, from a source language (L1) to a new language (L2), while many other non-linguistic explanations, e.g., improved initialization of position embeddings, can be potentially possible. In this study, to quantify the cross-linguistic transferability of linguistic evidence in cross-lingual LM training, we introduce a new experimental design, namely, a cross-lingual poverty-of-stimulus (CPOS) setting that ablates how LMs' hierarchical generalization in L2 can be led by structural evidence provided in L1. We contrast counterfactual L1 and L2 learning scenarios where the L2 corpus is ambiguous between linear and hierarchical grammar rules, while the amount of positive evidence for the hierarchical rule is controlled on the L1 side. Our experimental results show that LMs can partially, yet not perfectly, transfer L1 structural evidence to L2, yielding only a small but detectable hierarchical bias, while the strength of transfer depends on language pairs. We further ablate the conditions for successful transfer, motivated by recent reports on the substantial impact of vocabulary overlap. We indeed find that vocabulary overlap is crucial even for the cross-lingual transfer of hierarchical syntactic generalization. This suggests that this also explains the language-pair-dependent tendencies in the main experiments and suggests that the transfer of linguistic evidence in continued new-language learning is only conditionally achievable.
title: Once a Tree, Always a Tree? Cross-lingual Transfer of Hierarchical Generalization in Language Models
title_translated: 一旦为树，永为树？语言模型中层次泛化的跨语言迁移
summary_translated: 语言模型（LMs）在持续（预）训练过程中常表现出成功的跨语言迁移，但其内在机制仍不明确。一种可能性是，语言模型能够从源语言（L1）中利用语言普遍原则的证据，即层次结构，迁移到新语言（L2），而其他非语言学解释（如位置嵌入初始化的改进）也可能存在。本研究通过引入一种新的实验设计——跨语言刺激匮乏（CPOS）设置，量化了跨语言语言证据的可迁移性，该设置消除了L1提供的结构证据对L2层次泛化的影响。我们对比了反事实的L1和L2学习场景，其中L2语料在线性与层次语法规则之间存在歧义，而L1侧对层次规则的正向证据量被控制。实验结果表明，语言模型能部分但不完全地将L1的结构证据迁移到L2，产生微弱但可检测到的层次偏差，且迁移强度依赖于语言对。我们进一步分析了成功迁移的条件，受近期关于词汇重叠重大影响报告的启发，发现词汇重叠即使在层次句法泛化跨语言迁移中也至关重要。这解释了主实验中语言对依赖性的倾向，并表明在持续的新语言学习中，语言证据的迁移仅在特定条件下才可实现。

summary: We present IQuest-Q1, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) agentic foundation model with 320B total parameters (15B activated). IQuest-Q1 is developed through a three-stage process: (1) stable and efficient pre-training, combining Stable SplitNorm, Muon, and muP with a two-stage curriculum whose second stage increases the coding-data mixture, preserving a wide stability margin between safe and optimal learning rates; (2) fine-grained mid-training, expanding the data mixture across domains and formats and progressively extending the context; and (3) multi-scaffold with multi-version post-training, combining SFT, domain-specialized RL, and MOPD across various scaffolds to integrate complementary training signals and strengthen agentic coding capabilities. Furthermore, model merging combines different experts and checkpoints from different stages while mitigating conflicts among their parameter updates. The resulting IQuest-Q1 demonstrates capabilities in both coding and general tasks. We release IQuest-Q1 as an open-source model to support community research and development.
title: IQuest-Q1: Advancing Foundation Capabilities for Agentic CLI Systems
title_translated: IQuest-Q1：推进智能体CLI系统的基础能力
summary_translated: 我们提出IQuest-Q1，一个具有3200亿总参数（激活参数150亿）的稀疏专家混合（MoE）智能体基础模型。IQuest-Q1通过三个阶段开发：(1) 稳定高效的预训练，结合稳定分层归一化（Stable SplitNorm）、Muon和muP，并采用两阶段课程，第二阶段增加编码数据比例，保持安全与最优学习率之间的宽稳定性裕度；(2) 细粒度中期训练，扩展数据混合覆盖多个领域和格式，并逐步延长上下文长度；(3) 多架构多版本后训练，结合监督微调（SFT）、领域专用强化学习（RL）和MOPD，整合互补训练信号以增强智能体编码能力。此外，模型融合技术在不同阶段的专家和检查点间合并，同时缓解参数更新间的冲突。最终的IQuest-Q1在编码和通用任务中均展现出强大能力。我们已将IQuest-Q1开源，以支持社区的研究与开发。

summary: Ophthalmic clinical decision support requires fast, accurate, and privacy-preserving inference, yet autoregressive large language models (LLMs) incur substantial latency and computational overhead for decisions among predefined actions. We therefore investigate a decision-oriented alternative to generative reasoning. Specifically, we first introduce RetiJev-Data, a source-grounded ophthalmology corpus comprising 78,158 clinical-decision and diagnosis questions derived from articles in PubMed Central and a MeSH vocabulary covering 531 eye diseases, and 50,074 guideline-grading questions spanning 11 grading systems, along with a 24,662-question evaluation benchmark. Based on this, we develop RetiJev, a family of 0.8B-9B decision models that directly score candidate answers without autoregressive decoding. Across all model sizes, RetiJev outperforms both a 27B LLM and the commercial Jev 1.13 decision model on guideline grading by 10.4-23.0 points. RetiJev-9B further achieves the highest accuracy on clinical decisions, improving over both baselines by 5.4-6.5 points while matching them on diagnosis. It answers a case in 158 ms on one GPU, 3.5x faster than LLM generation and 470x faster than reasoning. Models are released at https://github.com/Awenbocc/RetiJev.
title: RetiJev: Fast and Source-Grounded Ophthalmic Decision Models
title_translated: RetiJev：快速且基于来源的眼科决策模型
summary_translated: 眼科临床决策支持需要快速、准确且保护隐私的推理，但自回归大语言模型（LLMs）在预定义动作中做出决策时会产生显著延迟和计算开销。因此，我们探索了一种面向决策的生成推理替代方案。具体而言，我们首先引入RetiJev-Data，一个基于来源的眼科语料库，包含78,158个来自PubMed Central文章的临床决策与诊断问题，以及涵盖531种眼病的MeSH词汇表，还有50,074个跨越11种评分体系的指南评分问题，以及一个包含24,662个问题的评估基准。基于此，我们开发了RetiJev系列0.8B至9B的决策模型，直接对候选答案进行评分，无需自回归解码。在所有模型规模下，RetiJev在指南评分上均优于27B LLM和商业版Jev 1.13决策模型，得分高出10.4至23.0分。RetiJev-9B在临床决策上达到最高准确率，相比两个基线分别提升5.4至6.5分，而在诊断任务上与之持平。该模型在单张GPU上处理一个病例仅需158毫秒，比LLM生成快3.5倍，比推理快470倍。相关模型已在https://github.com/Awenbocc/RetiJev发布。

summary: Activation verbalizers translate the internal representations of large language models into human-readable text. The recently proposed natural language autoencoders (NLAs) learn this by reconstructing activations through a natural language bottleneck. However, it remains unclear how well these methods generalize beyond the setting they were trained for. Here, we study this question for NLAs along four closely related questions: (i) Do NLA verbalizations exhibit compositional structure with respect to their input? (ii) Do NLAs generalize to finetuned versions of the model they were trained for? (iii) Can NLAs recover finetuning objectives in model diffing? (iv) Can NLAs be specialized for model diffing? Across four models from three families, our experiments provide evidence supporting a largely positive answer to all four questions. Specifically, verbalizations of composed analogy activations mostly name the target while rarely mentioning the subtracted word, and an NLA can be reused on lightweight finetunes of its original model without retraining, with reconstruction quality degrading noticeably only for the largest model. Verbalizing activation differences between Taboo model organisms and their original models recovers the concealed secret word for most organisms, and reinforcement learning on activation differences further improves this recovery on held-out organisms. We also find that NLAs can recover the finetuning objective without the finetuned model generating any token, since the most informative token positions precede the user prompt. NLAs do not yet match state-of-the-art model diffing methods on the emergent misalignment detection task, but outperform a blackbox baseline. Our findings suggest that NLAs can meaningfully verbalize differences in activation space, rendering NLAs a promising direction for future work.
title: Verbalizing Activation Differences with Natural Language Autoencoders
title_translated: 使用自然语言自编码器描述激活差异
summary_translated: 激活描述器将大型语言模型的内部表示转化为人类可读文本。最近提出的自然语言自编码器（NLAs）通过自然语言瓶颈重建激活来学习这一过程。然而，这些方法在训练设定之外的泛化能力尚不明确。本文围绕四个密切相关的问题研究NLAs的泛化能力：(i) NLA描述是否具有输入的组合结构？(ii) NLAs能否泛化到其训练模型的微调版本？(iii) NLAs能否在模型差异分析中恢复微调目标？(iv) NLAs能否专门用于模型差异分析？在来自三个家族的四个模型上的实验提供了对上述四个问题的总体肯定回答。具体而言，复合类比激活的描述大多命名目标词，极少提及被减去的词；NLA可在无需重新训练的情况下应用于其原始模型的轻量级微调版本，仅在最大模型上重建质量明显下降。对禁忌模型生物体与其原始模型之间的激活差异进行描述，可恢复大多数生物体的隐藏秘密词，且对激活差异进行强化学习可进一步提升在未见生物体上的恢复效果。我们还发现，NLAs可在不生成任何token的情况下恢复微调目标，因为最具信息量的token位置位于用户提示之前。尽管NLAs尚未在新兴错位检测任务上超越最先进的模型差异分析方法，但优于黑盒基线。我们的发现表明，NLAs能够有意义地描述激活空间中的差异，使其成为未来研究的有前景方向。

summary: With external tools, large language models (LLMs) can tackle complex tasks through sustained environmental interaction. LLM-based agents are therefore increasingly used to tackle complex long-horizon tasks in real-world environments. However, these tasks involve sequential, interdependent decisions and changes in environmental states. Early execution errors affect subsequent interaction histories and environmental states, and their effects accumulate along the decision chain. To address this challenge, we propose Reflection-Guided Policy Optimization (ReflectPO), a reinforcement learning framework for autonomous error recovery in long-horizon tasks. ReflectPO comprises two core components. The first is Reflection-Guided Sampling. We use branch differences and repeated visits in interaction trajectories to construct hints for error recovery. The second is Tree-Structured Credit Assignment. We organize sampled trajectories into trees and assign action-level credit using parent--child reward differences and recovery gains. Experiments over two long-horizon tool-use benchmarks show that ReflectPO outperforms multiple existing baselines in most domains. It also achieves the best overall performance on average. Further analyses show that ReflectPO effectively improves agents' ability to recognize their own deviations, recover from erroneous states, and continue making progress toward task completion.
title: ReflectPO: Reflection-Guided Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
title_translated: ReflectPO：反思引导的策略优化用于长时程LLM智能体
summary_translated: 借助外部工具，大型语言模型（LLMs）可通过持续的环境交互解决复杂任务。因此，基于LLM的智能体越来越多地被用于真实环境中解决复杂的长时程任务。然而，这些任务涉及序列化、相互依赖的决策以及环境状态的变化。早期执行错误会影响后续交互历史和环境状态，其影响沿决策链累积。为应对这一挑战，我们提出反思引导的策略优化（ReflectPO），一种用于长时程任务中自主错误恢复的强化学习框架。ReflectPO包含两个核心组件：第一是反思引导采样。我们利用交互轨迹中的分支差异和重复访问构建错误恢复提示；第二是树状信用分配。我们将采样的轨迹组织成树结构，并通过父-子奖励差异和恢复收益来分配动作级别的信用。在两个长时程工具使用基准上的实验表明，ReflectPO在多数领域优于多个现有基线，在平均表现上也达到最佳。进一步分析显示，ReflectPO有效提升了智能体识别自身偏差、从错误状态恢复并继续推进任务完成的能力。

summary: Silicon sampling generates survey respondents by having a large language model (LLM) answer a survey as a person with given demographic attributes, and the resulting synthetic populations are increasingly used in place of human ones. Existing evaluations focus on individual-answer accuracy, per-question answer distributions, and correlations across questions. None of these compares the respondents themselves, so a generator whose respondents have combinations of answers found in no human respondent can still score well if it reproduces every answer distribution. We propose the respondent coverage gap (RCG), which represents each respondent as a point defined by their complete answer profile and measures how far each human respondent is from the nearest generated one, relative to the distance between human samples. On two US social surveys, all six LLMs we evaluate leave human respondents uncovered, and under our main settings, they fall behind a baseline that samples each answer independently from the human marginals. Across the prompting and inference settings we test, every LLM has a higher RCG than a Gaussian copula fitted to the human data.
title: Silicon Samples Match the Answers but Not the Respondents
title_translated: 硅基样本匹配答案但不匹配受访者
summary_translated: 硅基采样通过让大语言模型（LLM）以给定人口统计属性扮演受访者来生成调查受访者，合成群体正越来越多地替代人类群体。现有评估主要关注单个答案的准确性、每道题的答案分布以及问题间的相关性。但这些评估均未比较受访者本身，因此即使生成器的受访者组合在真实人类中从未出现过，只要复制了每个答案的分布，仍可能获得高分。我们提出响应者覆盖差距（RCG），将每位受访者表示为由其完整回答特征定义的点，并衡量每位真实受访者到最近生成受访者距离相对于真实样本间距离的比例。在两项美国社会调查上，我们评估的六种LLM均未能覆盖真实受访者，且在主要设置下，其表现落后于从人类边际分布独立采样答案的基线方法。在测试的所有提示和推理设置中，每种LLM的RCG均高于拟合至人类数据的高斯连结模型。

summary: Cyberbullying involves behavioral and contextual patterns beyond isolated abusive messages. However, existing approaches remain fragmented across content detection, semantic representation, and network analysis, with limited interpretable perpetrator representations, multi-scale structural modeling, and explanations of behavior-driven similarity and influence propagation. These limitations hinder the identification of persistent perpetrators, characterization of behavioral communities, and assessment of potentially influential users. This paper proposes Ontology-Driven Cyberbullying Behavior and Network Analysis (ODCBNA), a perpetrator-centric framework integrating requirements-driven ontology design, knowledge graph construction, behavioral modeling, community analysis, and influence modeling. Using the Bengali Contextual and Diverse Cyberbullying (BenCoDiC) corpus as a use case, ODCBNA identifies $1{,}063$ users with at least three bullying comments or replies as perpetrators and represents each through a $64$-dimensional behavioral and contextual feature vector. Cosine similarity and $k$-nearest-neighbor modeling produce a weighted network with $27{,}554$ edges. Louvain analysis identifies six communities with a modularity of approximately $0.495$ and $27$ sub-communities. Feature-contribution analysis identifies the Video, Impact, and User Profile groups as the strongest contributors to behavioral similarity and community separation, while contextual dimensions support interpretation. Community-constrained influence analysis shows that IM Greedy achieves small positive gains in all six communities, although different seed-selection methods produce comparable diffusion spreads despite limited seed overlap. These findings provide an interpretable basis for understanding perpetrator behavior, community organization, and potential influence patterns in Bengali online environments.
title: From Perpetrators' Digital Footprints to Behavioral Communities: An Ontology-Driven Framework for Bengali Cyberbullying Analysis--- FULL VERSION
title_translated: 从施暴者的数字足迹到行为社区：一种面向孟加拉语网络欺凌分析的本体驱动框架——完整版
summary_translated: 网络欺凌涉及孤立的辱骂信息之外的行为与情境模式。然而，现有方法在内容检测、语义表示和网络分析方面仍呈碎片化，缺乏可解释的施暴者表征、多尺度结构建模，以及对行为驱动相似性和影响传播的解释。这些局限性阻碍了持续施暴者的识别、行为社区的刻画及潜在影响力用户的评估。本文提出本体驱动的网络欺凌行为与网络分析（ODCBNA）框架，采用以需求为导向的本体设计、知识图谱构建、行为建模、社区分析和影响建模，实现以施暴者为中心的整合。以孟加拉语上下文与多样化网络欺凌（BenCoDiC）语料库为用例，ODCBNA识别出1063名至少发布三条欺凌评论或回复的用户，并将其表示为64维的行为与情境特征向量。通过余弦相似度与k近邻建模构建加权网络，包含27,554条边。Louvain分析识别出六个模块度约为0.495的社区及27个子社区。特征贡献分析表明，视频、影响和用户资料组是行为相似性和社区分离的最强贡献者，而情境维度有助于解释。社区约束的影响分析显示，IM Greedy在所有六个社区中取得微小正向提升，尽管不同种子选择方法产生相近的扩散范围，尽管种子重叠有限。这些发现为理解孟加拉语在线环境中施暴者行为、社区组织及潜在影响模式提供了可解释基础。

summary: Nepali-English code-switched conversational speech presents severe challenges for automatic speech recognition (ASR), chiefly through script confusion (inappropriate mixing of Devanagari and Latin orthography) and elevated error rates at language switch points. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can adapt multilingual foundation models, but human code-switched audio is expensive to collect and annotate. We curate a new benchmark of 13,044 spontaneous podcast utterances (15.45 h total; 10,214 test, 2,830 dev), audited and verified to eliminate machine translation leakages and acoustic loops. We investigate a two-stage synthetic-to-real adaptation framework: Stage 1 applies SFT on 0.95 h of speech synthesized via a multi-speaker, dual-engine TTS pipeline; Stage 2 explores Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with transcription and script rewards. We find that synthetic SFT provides the primary cross-domain transfer to spontaneous human speech, reducing Mixed Error Rate (MER) from 23.40% to 21.52% (-1.88 pp) and switch-point error rate (SPER) from 35.89% to 28.77% (-7.12 pp). Subsequent GRPO yields small, statistically significant adjustments on 173 test utterances (1.69%), driving English script confusion (SCR_en) from 6.45% to 6.36% (p <= 0.001) and SPER to 28.70% (p = 0.022 clustered). Crucially, ablation reveals that in this SFT-converged encoder-decoder setting, an auxiliary script reward term yields performance identical to MER-only optimization because rollout candidate groups exhibit near-zero script variance on synthetic data. On monolingual benchmarks, SFT improves Nepali MER by 2.71 pp (stabilizing at 18.42% after GRPO, a 2.38 pp gain over baseline) while preserving English lexical WER (3.38% vs. 3.33%). Verified transcripts, timestamps, episode metadata, and reconstruction scripts are publicly released.
title: Synthetic-to-Real Code-Switched ASR: A Spontaneous Nepali-English Podcast Benchmark

title_translated: 从合成到真实：尼泊尔语-英语代码切换语音识别的自发播客基准
summary_translated: 尼泊尔语-英语代码切换对话语音对自动语音识别（ASR）构成严峻挑战，主要表现为脚本混淆（Devanagari与拉丁字母不当混合）以及语言切换点处错误率升高。监督微调（SFT）可适应多语言基础模型，但收集和标注真实的代码切换音频成本高昂。我们构建了一个新的基准，包含13,044段自发播客语句（总计15.45小时；测试集10,214条，开发集2,830条），经过审计和验证以消除机器翻译泄露和声学回环。我们研究了一种两阶段合成到真实迁移框架：第一阶段在0.95小时通过多说话人、双引擎TTS管道生成的语音上进行SFT；第二阶段探索基于转录和脚本奖励的组相对策略优化（GRPO）。结果表明，合成SFT提供了主要的跨域迁移能力，使混合错误率（MER）从23.40%降至21.52%（下降1.88个百分点），语言切换点错误率（SPER）从35.89%降至28.77%（下降7.12个百分点）。后续GRPO在173个测试语句上带来微小但统计显著的改进（1.69%），使英语脚本混淆（SCR_en）从6.45%降至6.36%（p ≤ 0.001），SPER降至28.70%（p = 0.022，聚类检验）。关键的是，消融实验表明，在SFT收敛的编码器-解码器设置下，辅助脚本奖励项的表现与仅优化MER相同，因为合成数据上的滚动候选组脚本方差接近零。在单语基准上，SFT使尼泊尔语MER降低2.71个百分点（GRPO后稳定在18.42%，比基线提升2.38个百分点），同时保持英语词汇错误率（WER）不变（3.38% vs. 3.33%）。经验证的转录文本、时间戳、节目元数据和重建脚本已公开发布。

summary: Ambiguity is a central feature of natural communication: a sentence, image, or sound may remain underspecified until evidence from the other channels is considered. Yet current multimodal benchmarks mostly test perception, recognition, or reasoning over already determinate inputs, leaving unclear whether omni-modal large language models can resolve ambiguity distributed across text, vision, and audio. We introduce TRIAD, a benchmark for omni-modal ambiguity resolution. Each item is a text--image--audio triplet paired with a question and a set of answer options, and is constructed so that the full triplet determines a unique answer while removing any one modality makes the set of consistent options non-unique. TRIAD contains $327$ hand-written queries in $86$ scene groups and covers $18$ ambiguity categories across the three modalities. Evaluating $14$ omni-modal systems reveals that strong item-level performance does not translate into robust scene-level disambiguation: the best model still trails humans by over $20$ points in group accuracy. Removing answer options widens the gap further, driving model group accuracy to the single digits while humans remain robust. Leave-one-out and transcript/description counterfactuals further show that current systems often underuse audio cues when text and image are present. TRIAD reframes omni-modal evaluation around disambiguation rather than recognition, and provides a taxonomy, benchmark, and diagnostic protocol for measuring this capability.
title: TRIAD: Benchmarking Omni-Modal Ambiguity in Multimodal Large Language Models
title_translated: TRIAD：多模态大语言模型中全模态模糊性的基准测试
summary_translated: 模糊性是自然交流的核心特征：一句话、一幅图像或一段声音在其他通道提供证据前可能保持未明确状态。然而，当前多模态基准大多测试感知、识别或已有确定输入的推理，无法判断全模态大语言模型能否解决分布在文本、视觉和音频中的模糊性。我们引入TRIAD，一个用于全模态模糊性解析的基准。每个条目是一个文本-图像-音频三元组，配以一个问题和一组答案选项，构造方式确保只有完整三元组才能确定唯一答案，而移除任一模态后，一致选项集合将不再唯一。TRIAD包含327个手工编写的查询，涵盖86个场景组，覆盖三个模态的18类模糊性。对14个全模态系统的评估显示，强的条目级性能并未转化为稳健的场景级消歧能力：最佳模型在场景准确率上仍比人类落后超过20分。去除答案选项进一步扩大差距，使模型场景准确率降至个位数，而人类仍保持稳健。留一法和转录/描述反事实分析进一步表明，当文本和图像存在时，当前系统往往低估音频线索。TRIAD将全模态评估重新聚焦于消歧而非识别，并提供了分类体系、基准和诊断协议以衡量此能力。

summary: LLMs are increasingly used as AI tutors, yet existing benchmarks overlook the challenging behaviors common among students with learning and behavioral difficulties. We introduce TutorCaseBench, a benchmark that grounds AI-tutor evaluation in qualitative case studies from pedagogy, educational psychology, and special education. Our pipeline converts documented student categories into case-specific scenarios, tutor-student dialogues, and rubrics grounded in source evidence. The benchmark contains 923 dialogues across five challenge types, evaluated through open-ended response generation (1,560 items) and multiple-choice selection (2,537 items). Across 11 state-of-the-art LLMs, even the strongest model satisfies a rubric criterion in only 55.8% of open-ended cases, while models are better at selecting appropriate strategies than generating situated responses. These results reveal a gap between intervention recognition and context-specific adaptation, especially for open-weight models. All data are publicly available at https://github.com/kixlab/TutorCaseBench.
title: TutorCaseBench: A Case-Grounded Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Tutors in Supporting Students with Challenging Behaviors
title_translated: TutorCaseBench：评估支持有挑战性行为学生的LLM导师的案例基础基准
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作AI导师，但现有基准忽略了学习与行为困难学生中常见的挑战性行为。我们引入TutorCaseBench，一个将AI导师评估扎根于教育学、教育心理学和特殊教育领域质性案例研究的基准。我们的流程将已记录的学生类别转化为特定案例情景、师生对话及基于原始证据的评分标准。该基准包含五类挑战类型共923段对话，通过开放式应答生成（1,560项）和多项选择题（2,537项）进行评估。在11个最先进的LLM中，即使最强模型也仅在55.8%的开放式案例中满足评分标准，而模型在选择合适策略方面优于生成情境化回应。这些结果揭示了干预识别与情境化适应之间的差距，尤其在开放权重模型中更为明显。所有数据均可在https://github.com/kixlab/TutorCaseBench公开获取。

summary: Language models are aligned to avoid using protected attributes such as race, ethnicity, and gender to inform their responses. Therefore, they increasingly refuse or hedge when such attributes appear in a prompt. However, if a system must decide how much to learn from what people tell it, it is costly to refuse valuable information because of its source. In this article, we measure the cost of declining information in a two-urn game with an exact Bayesian answer. We present leading LLM models from two developers (OpenAI and Anthropic) with a prompt that requires them to decide how far to trust an unverifiable report from a participant whose description we randomize across ten configurations (6,600 sessions). We show that leading models often decline to assess the reporter, treating information as worthless at rates set by the description rather than by the evidence. At its widest, models decline a Black-described reporter 46% of the time and a white-described reporter 9%; yet, when they do assess the information, the Black-described reporter receives slightly more trust. The bias is invisible to audits that compare average trust or look only at assessed cases. It grows with reasoning effort, follows words rather than categories (models invoke race for "Black" but not for its Spanish translation negro, and never for "Indigenous"), and worsens under warning instructions a practitioner would try first. We also present a scoring option that reduces the refusal rate bias. When a model's trust is scored against revealed truth over repeated rounds, it credits identical records equally. In four of five configurations from Anthropic and OpenAI, the racial gap in trust falls below 0.02 by the last rounds.
title: Invisibilization as a Source of Probability Bias in Language Models
title_translated: 语言模型中概率偏差的隐形化来源
summary_translated: 语言模型被对齐以避免使用种族、族裔和性别等受保护属性来影响其回应。因此，当提示中出现这些属性时，它们越来越倾向于拒绝或含糊其辞。然而，如果系统必须决定从人们提供的信息中学习多少，仅因信息来源而拒绝有价值的信息是代价高昂的。本文通过一个具有精确贝叶斯解的双瓮游戏测量了拒绝信息的成本。我们测试了来自两家开发者的领先大语言模型（OpenAI 和 Anthropic），在需要它们判断一位参与者不可验证报告可信度的提示下，该参与者的描述在十个配置中随机变化（共6,600次会话）。结果显示，领先模型经常拒绝评估报告者，将信息视为无价值，其拒绝率由描述设定而非证据决定。最严重时，描述为黑人的报告者被拒绝46%的时间，而白人描述者仅为9%；但当模型确实评估信息时，黑人描述者反而获得略高的信任。这种偏差在审计中难以察觉，因为审计通常比较平均信任度或仅关注已评估案例。该偏差随推理努力增加，遵循词语而非类别（模型对“Black”调用种族概念，但不对西班牙语中的“negro”或“Indigenous”这样做），且在从业者常采用的警告指令下恶化。我们还提出一种评分机制可降低拒绝率偏差：当模型的信任度在重复轮次中与真实情况对比时，相同记录会被同等打分。在Anthropic和OpenAI的五种配置中，有四种在最后轮次中信任的种族差距降至0.02以下。

summary: Do people who speak different languages organize concepts in similar ways? This question lies at the heart of the Sapir--Whorf hypothesis and debates about linguistic relativity. Shared basic meanings, however, need not imply shared relations among them. We compared relations among 196 basic concepts across 81 languages, using word embeddings from two multilingual models to quantify conceptual structure expressed in language. Cross-language correspondence was greater for sociocultural meanings than for meanings concerning nature and motion, a contrast recurring across models and classifications. Within the sociocultural domain, relational differences increased with geographic separation; less closely related languages differed more across all domains. These findings suggest that universality and relativity are interwoven across conceptual domains. They inform an account in which shared cognitive resources interact with linguistic and local experience, and predict greater cross-language correspondence in human semantic judgments for sociocultural than for nature and motion meanings.
title: Where meanings converge and diverge: Revisiting linguistic relativity across 81 languages
title_translated: 意义的汇聚与分歧：跨81种语言重新审视语言相对性
summary_translated: 说不同语言的人是否以相似方式组织概念？这一问题核心源于萨丕尔-沃尔夫假说及关于语言相对性的争论。共享的基本意义并不意味着它们之间的关系也相同。我们利用两种多语言模型的词嵌入，量化语言表达的概念结构，比较了81种语言中196个基本概念之间的关系。跨语言对应性在社会文化意义方面高于自然与运动相关意义，这一差异在不同模型和分类体系中反复出现。在社会文化领域内，关系差异随地理距离增加而增大；语言关联越远，各领域差异越大。这些发现表明，普遍性与相对性在概念领域中交织共存。研究支持一种观点：共享的认知资源与语言及本地经验相互作用，并预测在人类语义判断中，社会文化意义的跨语言一致性高于自然与运动意义。

summary: Guardrail models are increasingly used as safety layers for LLMs and agentic systems, but most are trained on fixed prompt or response interfaces and become unreliable when the same safety case appears as a conversation, agent trajectory, multi-agent trace, or policy-conditioned input. We propose UniGuard, a training framework that learns interface-invariant safety representations from multiple semantically aligned views of the same safety case. We also construct the UniGuard-FT dataset by transforming 1,000 public safety cases into prompt, response, multi-turn conversation, agent-trace, and multi-agent-trace views, and train UniGuard-0.6B with classification, supervised contrastive learning, and asymmetric confidence calibration losses. Across unseen-interface benchmarks ATBench, PolicyGuardBench, and DynaBench, UniGuard-0.6B improves over its pretrained guardrail by 45.12 F1 points on average and reduces expected calibration error by 35.41 points, while remaining competitive with much larger guardrails such as Claude-Sonnet-4.5 and GPT-5.2 - despite being a 0.6B model and trained only with synthetic data.
title: UniGuard: Multi-View Guardrail Learning for Cross-Interface Safety Generalization
title_translated: UniGuard：面向跨接口安全泛化的多视角护栏学习
summary_translated: 护栏模型越来越多地被用作大语言模型和智能体系统的安全层，但大多数模型在固定提示或响应接口上训练，当同一安全案例以对话、代理轨迹、多智能体轨迹或策略条件输入等形式出现时，其可靠性下降。我们提出UniGuard，一种从同一安全案例的多个语义对齐视图中学习接口无关安全表示的训练框架。我们构建了UniGuard-FT数据集，将1000个公开安全案例转换为提示、响应、多轮对话、代理轨迹和多智能体轨迹等多种视图，并使用分类、监督对比学习和非对称置信度校准损失训练UniGuard-0.6B模型。在未见过的接口基准测试ATBench、PolicyGuardBench和DynaBench上，UniGuard-0.6B平均比预训练护栏提升45.12 F1分，预期校准误差降低35.41点，同时在性能上仍可媲美更大的护栏模型如Claude-Sonnet-4.5和GPT-5.2——尽管其仅为0.6B参数规模，且仅使用合成数据训练。

summary: This paper studies the local geometry of semantic meaning in large language models. Current representation analyses ask whether meanings are close in embedding space, or whether linear probes separate semantic classes, but they do not characterize the within-concept local geometry: what is invariant across realizations of a single semantic factor, what varies, and what changes when meaning is refined. This paper characterizes that geometry through two controlled probes evaluated on four architecturally diverse decoder-only LLMs (Gemma 4, Llama 3.2, Qwen 2.5, Pythia). A cross-lingual probe uses language as a perturbation to separate exact meaning matches, same-factor realizations, nearby concepts, and out-of-domain contrasts. A refinement probe separates specificity-bearing semantic narrowing from high-probability attributive elaboration and adversarial controls; both probes are validated by blind human judgments. Four findings recur across all models: under mean pooling, once dominant variance directions are removed, sentence pairs order by semantic relatedness (same factor, then same domain, then different domain) without overlap over a band of layers; semantic factors organize around an invariant core surrounded by structured realization-specific variation; refinement produces directed displacement into tighter neighborhoods, including against controls built on the same base noun; and sentence-level and token-local readouts expose complementary geometry (volume contraction at the sentence level, sharper anisotropic endpoints at token-local readout). We interpret these results as evidence that LLM semantics are organized as local anisotropic neighborhoods in which meaning contracts under refinement.
title: Meaning Contracts: Local Semantic Geometry in Large Language Models

title_translated: 意义契约：大语言模型中的局部语义几何
summary_translated: 本文研究大语言模型中语义意义的局部几何结构。当前的表征分析主要关注意义在嵌入空间中是否接近，或线性探测能否分离语义类别，但未能刻画单个语义因子内部的局部几何特征：哪些在不同实现中保持不变，哪些变化，以及意义细化时如何改变。本文通过两个受控探测器，在四款架构各异的仅解码器LLM（Gemma 4、Llama 3.2、Qwen 2.5、Pythia）上刻画该几何结构。跨语言探测利用语言作为扰动，区分精确意义匹配、同因子实现、邻近概念和域外对比；细化探测则分离出承载特异性语义缩小的部分与高概率属性扩展部分，以及对抗控制。两个探测均通过盲评人类判断验证。四个发现贯穿所有模型：在均值池化后，去除主导方差方向后，句子对按语义相关性排序（同因子 → 同领域 → 不同领域），且层间无重叠；语义因子围绕一个不变核心展开，周围是结构化的实现特定变异；细化导致向更紧密邻域的定向位移，包括对抗基于同一基础名词构建的控制；句子级与标记级读出揭示互补几何（句子级体积收缩，标记级读出呈现更锐利的各向异性终点）。我们解释这些结果为LLM语义组织成局部各向异性邻域的证据，其中意义在细化过程中发生收缩。

summary: Text embedding and text generation are two of the most useful capabilities of modern large language models, yet they are typically provided by separate specialized models (an embedder and a generator) trained with incompatible objectives and deployed side by side in retrieval-augmented generation and agent systems. Recent unified embedding-generation models such as GritLM share parameters between the two capabilities, but they either switch attention regimes between modes or optimize embedding and language modeling as parallel objectives that never supervise each other. We argue that these designs are only partially unified: the two capabilities coexist on the same weights, but do not shape each other. We propose ULME, a post-training framework that unifies embedding and language modeling on a causal decoder-only LLM through predictive coupling. ULME inserts a chain of learnable slots between the query and the answer, reads a semantic embedding and a reasoning embedding from two designated slots, and trains three objectives on a shared causal backbone: a contrastive loss anchoring the semantic slot to document representations, a language-modeling loss supervising answer generation, and a stop-gradient predictive loss that aligns the reasoning slot with a pooled summary of the answer, so that generation actively shapes what the embedding encodes. Across two model families (Qwen2.5, Qwen3) and eight scales spanning 0.5B-8B parameters, a single ULME checkpoint improves MTEB by 3.3-4.1 points over the strongest open-source baseline, tightens BRIGHT and AdvBench-IR simultaneously, and remains on par with a generation-only fine-tune on standard accuracy benchmarks (MMLU, GSM8K, MMLU-Pro, HumanEval), demonstrating that genuine unification yields mutually reinforcing rather than merely coexisting capabilities.
title: ULME: Predictive Coupling for Mutually Reinforcing Embedding and Language Modeling
title_translated: ULME：用于相互强化嵌入与语言建模的预测耦合
summary_translated: 文本嵌入和文本生成是现代大语言模型中最实用的两项能力，但通常由独立的专用模型提供（嵌入器与生成器），这些模型目标不兼容，部署于检索增强生成和智能体系统中并行运行。近年来，如GritLM等统一嵌入-生成模型虽共享参数，但要么在模式间切换注意力机制，要么将嵌入与语言建模作为并行目标优化，彼此从未相互监督。我们认为这些设计仅为部分统一：两种能力共存于同一权重，但并未相互塑造。我们提出ULME，一种基于因果解码器-only LLM的后训练框架，通过预测耦合实现嵌入与语言建模的真正统一。ULME在查询与答案之间插入一系列可学习槽位，从指定槽位读取语义嵌入与推理嵌入，并在共享因果主干上训练三个目标：锚定语义槽与文档表示的对比损失、监督答案生成的语言建模损失，以及带停止梯度的预测损失，使推理槽与答案汇总池化结果对齐，从而使生成主动塑造嵌入所编码的内容。在两个模型家族（Qwen2.5、Qwen3）和八个参数规模（0.5B–8B）上，单一ULME检查点在MTEB上优于最强开源基线3.3–4.1分，同时收紧BRIGHT和AdvBench-IR，且在标准准确率基准（MMLU、GSM8K、MMLU-Pro、HumanEval）上与仅生成微调模型持平，证明真正的统一能带来相互强化而非仅仅共存的能力。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) deployed in mental-health contexts can be evaluated for safety failures, but the resulting judgments are often difficult to inspect or explain. Common approaches to improving safety rely on prompt engineering, LLM-as-a-Judge, and Constitutional AI. In this work, we describe a clinician-led alternative in which two clinicians define, finalize, and adjudicate the four safety checks of a rule base, which is formally verified for internal consistency and applied as a guardrail over LLM outputs. Here and in the title, clinician-led refers to this rule base, not to the fact extractor or the uncertainty default, which are ours. Every verdict of the resulting verification layer is recomputable from a named rule and sixteen facts. Against an LLM judge matched in model, revision, quantization, rule text, and decoding but without the layer's computed 988/911 fact, the largest disagreement class, the satisfied-rule class, is structured: the Llama-3.3-70B judge, on its primary prompt, demands a crisis resource from 55 of the 65 replies (84.6%) that already contain one, while the same model, asked as a fact extractor, reports a recognized resource present on 54 of the 55. The verification layer never raises that demand, by construction. We report with equal prominence where this judge is stronger: fewer false crisis alarms on the one reference-scored check. We also report the measured cost (a specification revision raised block-class outcomes on held-out boundary prompts of an over-refusal benchmark from 6.0% to 16.0%, chiefly by changing fact extraction), the clinicians' decision to keep our uncertainty default, and the analysis of the result. The contribution is not a safer verdict. It is a guardrail whose disagreements with the judge localize to named rules and facts and whose measured costs trace to named facts and the uncertainty default.
title: From Clinical Judgment to Checkable Rules: Clinician-Led Guardrails for Mental-Health Chatbots
title_translated: 从临床判断到可验证规则：面向心理健康聊天机器人的临床医生主导的防护机制
summary_translated: 在心理健康场景中部署的大规模语言模型（LLMs）虽可评估安全缺陷，但其判断结果往往难以检查或解释。现有提升安全性的方法多依赖提示工程、LLM作为裁判和宪法AI。本文提出一种由临床医生主导的替代方案：两位临床医生定义、确定并裁定规则库中的四项安全检查，该规则库经过形式化验证以确保内部一致性，并作为防护机制应用于LLM输出。此处的‘临床医生主导’指规则库本身，而非事实提取器或不确定性默认值（后者由我们设计）。最终验证层的每项判决均可根据命名规则和十六个事实重新计算。与一个在模型、版本、量化、规则文本和解码方式上完全匹配但无该验证层计算出的988/911事实的LLM裁判相比，最大分歧类别——满足规则类——具有结构性特征：Llama-3.3-70B裁判在其主提示下，要求65条回复中的55条（84.6%）提供危机资源，而这些回复实际上已包含资源；同一模型作为事实提取器时，报告在55条中有54条存在已识别资源。而验证层则从不提出此类要求，这是设计使然。我们同样强调该裁判更强之处：在参考评分检查中，虚假危机警报更少。此外，我们报告了测量成本（一次规范修订导致保留边界提示上的过度拒绝基准结果从6.0%上升至16.0%，主要源于事实提取方式的改变）、临床医生决定保留我们的不确定性默认值，以及结果分析。本研究的贡献并非更安全的判决，而是一种防护机制：其与裁判的分歧可定位到具体规则和事实，且测量成本可追溯至特定事实和不确定性默认值。

summary: While there is increasing evidence that words are stored in the mental lexicon with some phonetic detail, there are open questions about exactly which phonetic details are stored and whether they are functionally relevant for spoken word recognition. Word-level phonetic cues, such as word duration, provide an appropriate test case. Across languages, including Mandarin Chinese, high frequency words are shorter than low frequency words. Using a homophone ordering task, we investigate whether differences in word duration impact word recognition. Mandarin Chinese was examined since it has abundant disyllabic homophones. Our results indicate that participants were able to use word duration to recognize the order of homophone pairs, selected to vary in lexical frequency. Both with high noise levels and when no other cues were available, participants mapped the shorter duration auditory stimulus to the higher frequency word. The results provide evidence that word duration can directly cue the identity of words, suggesting that it may be a phonetic detail incorporated into the lexical representation. We discuss this direct cueing account alongside alternative accounts of how word duration may modulate word recognition.
title: Direct cueing of word identity through word duration: evidence from Mandarin homophones
title_translated: 通过词持续时间直接提示词义：来自汉语同音词的证据
summary_translated: 尽管越来越多的证据表明词汇在心理词典中存储时带有某些语音细节，但关于哪些语音细节被存储以及它们是否对口语词识别具有功能性意义仍存在争议。词级语音线索（如词持续时间）是一个合适的检验案例。在多种语言中，包括汉语普通话，高频词比低频词更短。通过同音词排序任务，我们探究词持续时间差异是否影响词识别。选择汉语普通话是因为其拥有丰富的双音节同音词。研究结果表明，参与者能够利用词持续时间来识别同音词对的顺序，这些同音词在词汇频率上有所不同。即使在高噪声水平下或缺乏其他线索时，参与者仍将较短持续时间的听觉刺激对应于高频词。结果表明，词持续时间可以直接提示词的身份，暗示它可能已被纳入词汇表征中。我们还讨论了这一直接提示理论，以及词持续时间如何调节词识别的其他可能解释。

summary: Existing datasets on cultural knowledge have been typically created by human annotators familiar with each culture. However, the process requires considerable human effort, presenting a significant challenge to scalability. To address this challenge, we introduce WikiOriginQA, a QA dataset automatically constructed by objectively representing the origins of knowledge through the creation dates of different Wikipedia language editions. Experimental results with the created dataset confirm that LLM performance tends to be biased toward Anglophone cultures. Furthermore, the results suggest the importance of knowledge propagation into the Anglosphere. These findings demonstrate the validity of our automated approach, enabling cultural bias evaluations with superior scalability across diverse languages without extensive manual annotation.
title: WikiOriginQA: Automated Construction of a QA Dataset with Knowledge Origins for Analyzing Cultural Bias

title_translated: WikiOriginQA：基于知识来源自动构建的问答数据集以分析文化偏见
summary_translated: 现有的文化知识数据集通常由熟悉各文化的真人标注者创建。然而，这一过程需要大量人力，严重制约了可扩展性。为解决此挑战，我们引入WikiOriginQA，一个通过不同维基百科语言版本的创建日期客观表示知识来源而自动构建的问答数据集。使用该数据集的实验结果证实，LLM的表现倾向于偏向英语文化圈。此外，结果表明知识向盎格鲁文化圈传播的重要性。这些发现验证了我们自动化方法的有效性，使得跨多种语言的文化偏见评估具备卓越的可扩展性，无需大量人工标注。

summary: Singular-value spectra encode important structure in transformer feed-forward projections, yet their causal role in downstream behavior remains underexplored. We study post-hoc spectral smoothing and spiking interventions on the up_proj and down_proj matrices. Positive perturbation stretches deviations from the geometric mean, making large singular values larger and small ones smaller (spiking), and vice versa. The intervention preserves singular vectors and the geometric mean of the singular values. Across five open Llama and Qwen instruction models, we evaluate the perturbed systems on capability-labeled subtasks, standard and chain-of-thought reasoning benchmarks, judge-scored truthfulness, hallucination, and safety tasks, and TRAIT personality probes. To interpret score shifts, we fit responses in a three-dimensional capability basis consisting of factual knowledge, language understanding, and deductive reasoning. The induced changes suggest structured rather than purely random sensitivity: large positive perturbations more reliably suppress language and deductive responses, moderate negative perturbations can sometimes improve factual or task-local performance on the evaluated grids, and sensitivity varies strongly by model family, benchmark module, and underlying layerwise spectral inequality. These results position spectral perturbation as a lightweight intervention for probing how capabilities are organized and traded off in large language models.
title: Spectral Smoothing and Spiking Perturbations Reconfigure Capability Profiles and Selective Task Performance in Large Language Models
title_translated: 谱平滑与尖峰扰动重构大语言模型的能力分布与选择性任务表现
summary_translated: 奇异值谱编码了Transformer前馈投影中的重要结构，但其对下游行为的因果作用仍待深入探索。我们研究了对up_proj和down_proj矩阵进行事后谱平滑与尖峰干预的效果。正向扰动会放大偏离几何平均值的程度，使大奇异值更大、小奇异值更小（即尖峰），反之亦然。该干预保持奇异向量及奇异值的几何平均值不变。我们在五个开源的Llama和Qwen指令模型上，评估了扰动系统在能力标注子任务、标准与链式思维推理基准、裁判评分的真实性、幻觉与安全性任务，以及TRAIT人格探测上的表现。为解释得分变化，我们采用由事实知识、语言理解与演绎推理构成的三维能力基底拟合响应。结果表明，变化具有结构性而非纯粹随机性：大幅正向扰动更可靠地抑制语言与演绎类响应；适度负向扰动有时可提升事实或任务局部性能；敏感性随模型族、基准模块和分层谱不等性而显著变化。这些结果将谱扰动定位为一种轻量级干预手段，可用于探查大语言模型中能力的组织方式与权衡机制。

summary: Large language models increasingly act as controllers in structured decision pipelines, yet their decisions are still executed by autoregressive text decoding. Hierarchical RAG is one such setting: at each frontier of a document tree, an LLM commits to $b$ of $k$ sections under an input-dependent action grammar, executed as either failure-prone free-form JSON or reliable but strictly serial grammar-constrained generation. We show that this serialization is unnecessary for bounded-horizon control: the reachable future forms a shallow action-prefix tree, which we compile --- one root prefill plus one tree-causal probe evaluate every prefix-conditioned action distribution with serial decoding's tokens, positions, and causal ancestry. A prefix-state lemma makes compiled control policy-exact in exact arithmetic: the same policy with a two-forward critical path and zero output tokens. One further probe pass certifies the exact order-marginalized MAP set. Across four document-disjoint splits and two scales on the primary MetaX device, compiled control matches the serial policy on $84$--$89\%$ of questions --- every instrumented divergence a floating-point near-tie --- and cuts control latency by $35$--$47\%$ versus token-wise serial decoding and $6$--$7\%$ versus an idealized chunked engine; an H800 repetition preserves the ordering.
title: Compiling Autoregressive LLM Control into Policy-Exact Parallel Inference for Hierarchical RAG
title_translated: 将自回归LLM控制编译为策略精确的并行推理以实现层次化RAG
summary_translated: 大型语言模型越来越多地作为结构化决策流程中的控制器，但其决策仍通过自回归文本解码执行。层次化RAG即为一例：在文档树的每个前沿节点，LLM根据输入相关的动作语法选择k个中的b个部分，执行方式为易出错的自由格式JSON或可靠但严格串行的语法约束生成。我们证明，在有限视野控制下，这种串行化是不必要的：可达未来形成一个浅层动作前缀树，我们将其编译——仅需一次根预填充加一次树因果探测，即可对每个前缀条件下的动作分布进行串行解码的标记、位置和因果祖先评估。一个前缀状态引理使编译后的控制策略在精确算术下为策略精确：相同策略，仅有两条前向关键路径且零输出标记。再经一次探测可验证精确的顺序边际MAP集合。在四个文档互斥划分及两个规模的主MetaX设备上，编译控制在84%–89%的问题上与串行策略一致——所有仪器化偏差均为浮点近似平局——且相较于逐标记串行解码，控制延迟降低35%–47%，相较于理想化的分块引擎也降低6%–7%；H800重复实验保持了顺序一致性。

summary: Coding-agent benchmarks often describe a task in natural language but grade it with tests taken from the upstream project. Passing those tests can require information the description never states: a constant's name, a module path, an exact message. We call this a specification-oracle gap: where it exists, a benchmark also measures whether an agent reproduces upstream implementation details. We formalise the gap, including the inconsistencies that chains of dependent tasks add, and build a static audit for five languages that classifies every name-, path- and literal-level dependency of every scored test (held-out precision 89.2%, recall 92.9%). On SWE-Milestone (98 graded milestones, 35 published runs), 25 milestones contain a test that depends on an unstated, non-inferable name or path. Build units with such a dependency fail in 80.6% of runs, against 48.4% for comparable units without one, and withholding a single hidden name from the reference stops its unit's tests from compiling in 126 of 128 cases. The leaderboard's ranking is robust to removing the affected tests, but they shift scores within repositories and favour agents that reproduce upstream names. Across four further benchmarks, prevalence appears to follow construction: a third or more of the tasks are affected where specifications are release notes or LLM summaries, almost none where tasks are screened or written for their tests; how much a gap costs depends on how the harness grades. We release the audit, corrected filter lists and specification addenda.
title: What the Specification Did Not Say: Specification-Oracle Gaps in Test-Graded Coding-Agent Benchmarks
title_translated: 规范未言明之处：测试评分编码智能体基准中的规范-Oracle差距
summary_translated: 编码智能体基准通常以自然语言描述任务，但使用上游项目中的测试进行评分。通过这些测试可能需要规范中从未提及的信息：常量名称、模块路径、确切消息。我们称此为规范-Oracle差距：当此类差距存在时，基准也衡量智能体是否复现了上游实现细节。我们形式化了这一差距，包括依赖任务链带来的不一致问题，并构建了一个针对五种语言的静态审计工具，可分类每个评分测试在名称、路径和字面量层面的所有依赖关系（保留精度89.2%，召回率92.9%）。在SWE-Milestone（98个已评分里程碑，35次公开运行）中，25个里程碑包含依赖于未说明且无法推断的名称或路径的测试。具有此类依赖的构建单元在80.6%的运行中失败，而无此类依赖的同类单元仅48.4%失败；从参考答案中隐藏一个隐含名称，会导致其单元在128次中有126次无法编译。排行榜排名在移除受影响测试后仍保持稳健，但会改变仓库内部得分，并偏向于复现上游名称的智能体。在另外四个基准中，该差距的普遍性似乎与构建方式有关：当规范为发布说明或LLM摘要时，三分之一以上的任务受到影响；而当任务经过筛选或专为测试编写时，几乎不受影响；差距的成本取决于评测框架如何评分。我们发布了该审计工具、修正后的过滤列表及规范补充材料。

summary: Industry Foundation Classes (IFC), the standard for building information exchange in architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC), is increasingly queried through large language models (LLMs) using natural language. Evaluating these systems at scale is difficult because free-text answers require costly human or LLM-based review. We propose IFC-MCQ, a method that automatically generates multiple-choice benchmarks from IFC files for exact option-set grading. The taxonomy covers 15 categories and 36 subtypes across four groups, with answer keys derived from the file and distractors constructed from file-derived values or predefined rules. We applied IFC-MCQ to IFC models of varying sizes and modelling characteristics to assess generation coverage and evaluated two agentic configurations on selected models using tool- and code-based retrieval. The evaluation exposed category-specific failure modes and showed that performance can vary with the source IFC model and retrieval interface. IFC-MCQ enables scalable benchmarking of LLM-based IFC retrieval in AEC workflows.
title: IFC-MCQ: Automatically Generating Multiple-Choice Benchmarks for Evaluating LLM Agents on IFC Data Retrieval
title_translated: IFC-MCQ：自动生成用于评估LLM智能体在IFC数据检索中表现的多选题基准
summary_translated: 工业基础类（IFC）是建筑、工程与施工（AEC）领域建筑信息交换的标准，正越来越多地通过大型语言模型（LLM）以自然语言进行查询。由于自由文本回答需耗费大量人力或基于LLM的评审，大规模评估这些系统十分困难。我们提出IFC-MCQ方法，可从IFC文件自动生成多选题基准，支持精确选项集评分。该分类体系涵盖15个类别和36个子类型，分为四组，答案键来自文件内容，干扰项则由文件衍生值或预设规则生成。我们将IFC-MCQ应用于不同规模和建模特征的IFC模型，评估生成覆盖率，并在选定模型上使用基于工具和代码的检索方式评估两种智能体配置。评估揭示了特定类别的失败模式，并表明性能随源IFC模型和检索接口的不同而变化。IFC-MCQ实现了AEC工作流中基于LLM的IFC检索的可扩展基准测试。

summary: We present Protegrity-PII, a new PII decision model for structured and unstructured text. Protegrity-PII achieves a typed recall of 0.915 with a precision of 0.907 on a new benchmark we propose, PII-SCOPE. Our model processes text in 0.49 seconds per million characters at \$0.0005 per million characters on a single RTX 6000 using batched inference. Due in part to the expansive nature of the entity type taxonomy used in training, Protegrity-PII achieves superior out-of-distribution generalization when benchmarked against a selection of state of the art models and datasets.
title: Protegrity-PII Technical Report
title_translated: Protegrity-PII 技术报告
summary_translated: 我们提出Protegrity-PII，一种针对结构化和非结构化文本的新PII决策模型。在我们提出的新型基准PII-SCOPE上，Protegrity-PII实现了0.915的类型化召回率和0.907的精确率。该模型在单块RTX 6000上以批处理推理方式处理文本的速度为每百万字符0.49秒，成本仅为每百万字符0.0005美元。由于训练中使用的实体类型分类体系范围广泛，Protegrity-PII在多个前沿模型和数据集上的分布外泛化能力表现出色。

summary: LLM judges are used to determine which of two answers is better. Trusting these verdicts requires knowing how repeatable they are and how much they depend on the judge's instructions. We show that similar aggregate scores can conceal substantial changes in individual verdicts, both when the same setup is repeated and when the instructions change. Using 500 Arena-Hard v2.0 prompts with two models' answers held fixed, we run GPT-4.1 as the judge under all eight combinations of criteria, output format and task framing, and repeat every setup unchanged at temperature zero on a pinned model version. Rerunning the default setup moves the aggregate score by about one point but changes the win/tie/loss outcome on 21.2% of prompts. Instruction changes introduce further sensitivity: in one setup, which asks for the verdict without reasoning and also drops several other instructions, outcomes change on 28.2 percentage points more prompts than the two setups' unchanged reruns do on average, and the aggregate score falls by 4.09 points. In another, where the criteria prioritise accuracy, outcomes change on 6.7 percentage points more prompts by the same comparison, while the aggregate score barely moves. A stable aggregate score therefore does not establish that individual verdicts are repeatable. This distinction matters when those verdicts are used as preference labels or to assess individual responses. Evaluations that rely on individual verdicts should repeat each setup they use and report both aggregate scores and prompt-level agreement.
title: Behind Aggregate Scores: What Systematically Varying Arena-Hard's LLM Judge Reveals
comment: Accepted at the JUDGe workshop (Can We Trust the Judge?), NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival). 18 pages, 3 figures. Code and data: this https URL
title_translated: 聚合分数背后的真相：系统性变化的Arena-Hard LLM评判者揭示的问题
summary_translated: LLM评判者被用于判断两个回答中哪个更优。信任这些裁决结果需要了解其可重复性以及对评判指令的依赖程度。我们发现，相似的聚合分数可能掩盖个体裁决的显著变化，无论是在相同设置下重复运行，还是在指令发生变化时。我们使用500个Arena-Hard v2.0提示，固定两个模型的回答，以GPT-4.1作为评判者，在所有八个标准、输出格式和任务表述组合下运行，并在同一固定模型版本上以零温度重复每种设置。重新运行默认设置使聚合分数变动约1分，但导致21.2%的提示改变了胜/平/负结果。指令变化引入了额外敏感性：在一个要求不提供推理且省略多项指令的设置中，结果变化发生在比平均情况多出28.2个百分点的提示上，聚合分数下降4.09分；在另一个优先考虑准确性的设置中，结果变化多出6.7个百分点，而聚合分数几乎不变。因此，稳定的聚合分数并不能证明个体裁决具有可重复性。这一区别在裁决结果用作偏好标签或评估单个响应时至关重要。依赖个体裁决的评估应重复每种设置，并同时报告聚合分数和提示级一致性。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used to answer factual questions, but their answers can contain errors and must be fact-checked claim by claim. Yet the resulting score depends on three design decisions: which questions the claims answer, under what conditions each claim is judged, and which sources count as evidence. No existing benchmark specifies all three. We introduce JSFactCheckBench, a Japanese benchmark that specifies all three, with 1,913 claims from LLM answers to questions about misleading information that circulated on Japanese social media, each annotated for factuality at a reference time and for importance to the question, using evidence from preselected Web sources. Across six LLMs, all verify claims directly answering the question less accurately than supplementary claims, a gap that aggregate scores obscure. Scores also drop when models must locate the relevant content in longer or multiple sources and, for all four open models, when the surrounding question and response are added. These weaknesses are visible only because the benchmark records the conditions behind each label. A benchmark that leaves them implicit cannot reveal them.
title: Rethinking the Evaluation of LLM Fact-Checkers
title_translated: 重新思考LLM事实核查器的评估
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）被广泛用于回答事实性问题，但其回答可能包含错误，必须逐条进行事实核查。然而，最终得分取决于三个设计决策：所核查主张对应的问题、每条主张的评判条件，以及哪些来源被视为证据。现有任何基准均未明确指定这三个方面。我们引入JSFactCheckBench，一个日语基准，明确指定了这三个要素：包含1,913条来自LLM对日本社交媒体上误导性信息的问答的主张，每条主张均在参考时间点标注事实性，并根据预选网络来源标注其对问题的重要性。在六种LLM中，所有模型对直接回答问题的主张验证准确率均低于补充性主张，这一差距被聚合分数所掩盖。当模型需在更长或多个来源中定位相关内容时，得分也会下降；对于所有四种开源模型，当加入周围问题和回答时，得分同样下降。这些弱点之所以可见，是因为该基准记录了每个标签背后的具体条件。若基准隐含这些条件，则无法揭示这些缺陷。

summary: Recent advances in search agents have enabled large language models to tackle complex tasks by retrieving and synthesizing external information. However, existing search agents often lack search-state awareness, i.e., the ability to recognize what information has been obtained and what remains missing, leading to hallucinated reasoning and prematurely terminated search. To address this limitation, we propose Self-Assessment Reinforcement Learning (SARL), a reinforcement learning framework in which models learn to recognize their own search state during training and improve their search behavior accordingly, without requiring additional assessment at test time. SARL achieves this through a dual reward design that captures the corrective effect of each assessment while penalizing excessive reliance on it, jointly encouraging effective and efficient search trajectories. Under this setup, SARL achieves a 24.3% relative improvement over the strongest baseline, with average gains of 35.9% on multi-hop reasoning and 27.9% on deep research benchmarks against the strongest per-benchmark baselines. SARL further surpasses methods built on auxiliary supervision or multi-agent coordination, despite operating as a standalone RL framework with no inference-time scaffolding. Beyond final performance, SARL maintains training stability under extended search horizons, a regime where existing methods consistently degrade, enabling sustained gains as task complexity grows.
title: Self-Assessment Reinforcement Learning for Search-State Awareness in Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
title_translated: 用于检索增强型大语言模型中搜索状态感知的自评估强化学习
summary_translated: 近期搜索代理的发展使大语言模型能够通过检索和综合外部信息来处理复杂任务。然而，现有的搜索代理通常缺乏搜索状态感知能力，即无法识别已获取的信息和仍缺失的内容，导致幻觉推理和过早终止搜索。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了自评估强化学习（SARL），这是一种强化学习框架，模型在训练过程中学习识别自身搜索状态，并相应改进搜索行为，无需在测试时额外评估。SARL通过双重奖励设计捕捉每次评估的修正效果，同时惩罚对其过度依赖，共同促进有效且高效的搜索轨迹。在此设置下，SARL相较于最强基线实现了24.3%的相对提升，在多跳推理任务上平均提升35.9%，在深度研究基准上提升27.9%。尽管SARL作为独立的强化学习框架运行且无推理时支撑结构，仍超越了基于辅助监督或多智能体协作的方法。除了最终性能外，SARL在更长的搜索视野下也保持了训练稳定性，而现有方法在此类场景中持续退化，从而支持随着任务复杂度增加而持续提升。

summary: LLM-based chat agents are increasingly used for complex, multi-turn, multilingual medical triage in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), yet evaluation methods focus on single-turn, English-only benchmarks that primarily test the chatbots' knowledge. In practice, users are often confused, overwhelmed, or emotionally vulnerable, giving unclear, misspelled single-word answers or long messages in regional dialects, and the context of a conversation can shift rapidly. We propose SIM-UT (Simulation of User Behaviour for Triage), a multi-turn, simulation-based evaluation method that identifies ecologically valid, contextually relevant failure modes of LLM-based triage chat agents. Using SIM-UT, we evaluated three real-world WhatsApp-based health chatbots: a respiratory screening programme in India, a hearing health support programme in South Africa, and a diabetes and lifestyle coaching agent in Kenya. We compared a medically fine-tuned open model (MedGemma) against general-purpose frontier models (ChatGPT and Claude) across 5,000+ multilingual simulated conversation turns grounded in the personas, constraints, and communication patterns of the real user populations, over 2-4 iterative rounds. A key failure mode emerged in both model families: de-escalation risk. The agents initially identified medical emergencies correctly, but when the user minimised the symptoms without introducing new clinical information, they de-escalated, exhibiting clinically dangerous sycophancy, for example agreeing that vaginal bleeding in pregnancy was "not a problem" or that decreased fetal movements at 32 weeks "can be normal". We recommend user simulation-based behavioural evaluation, grounded in real user context and covering adversarial and edge cases, as standard practice for triage chatbots in production, so that safeguards can be added before deployment or in subsequent iterations.
title: SIM-UT: A User Simulation based Evaluation Framework for Medical Triage Chatbots
title_translated: SIM-UT：面向医疗分诊聊天机器人的用户行为模拟评估框架
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型的聊天代理正被越来越多地应用于低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）的复杂、多轮、多语言医疗分诊场景，但当前评估方法主要聚焦于单轮、仅英语的基准测试，主要检验聊天机器人知识水平。实际上，用户常常困惑、压力大或情绪脆弱，给出模糊、拼写错误的单字回答或使用地方方言的长消息，对话上下文可能迅速变化。我们提出SIM-UT（分诊用用户行为模拟），一种多轮、基于模拟的评估方法，用于识别LLM分诊聊天代理在生态有效性和上下文相关性方面的失效模式。利用SIM-UT，我们评估了三个真实世界的WhatsApp健康聊天机器人：印度的呼吸筛查项目、南非的听力健康支持项目以及肯尼亚的糖尿病与生活方式教练代理。我们将医学微调的开源模型（MedGemma）与通用前沿模型（ChatGPT和Claude）进行了比较，覆盖超过5000轮多语言模拟对话，基于真实用户群体的人物设定、约束条件和沟通模式，进行2-4轮迭代。一个关键失效模式在两类模型中均出现：降级风险。这些代理最初能正确识别医疗紧急情况，但当用户淡化症状且未引入新临床信息时，它们会降低严重性判断，表现出临床上危险的迎合倾向，例如同意妊娠期阴道出血‘不是问题’，或认为孕32周胎动减少‘可能是正常的’。我们建议将基于用户模拟的行为评估作为生产环境中分诊聊天机器人的标准实践，基于真实用户情境并涵盖对抗性和边缘案例，以便在部署前或后续迭代中加入安全机制。

summary: LLM agents are flexible in language interaction, but using them as long-horizon planners is costly and prone to hallucinated or invalid actions. This paper targets a different role for LLMs: constrained bridges between language and symbolic planning. We propose MemPlan, a memory-conditioned PDDL planning framework for partially observable interactive text environments. MemPlan keeps the PDDL domain fixed and reconstructs the PDDL problem at each step from parsed observations, candidate hypotheses, and interaction memory. Positive graph memory assigns relevance-based action costs to candidate hypotheses for missing objects, locations, or conditions, guiding the planner toward more plausible checks. Negative memory records execution-refuted assumptions and compiles them into exclusion constraints, preventing repeated attempts at candidates already contradicted by feedback. A unified schema-conditioned language--symbol interface, trained offline with supervised fine-tuning, connects text environments to the planning loop through observation-to-fact parsing and symbolic-action-to-command grounding. Experiments on TextWorld, ALFWorld, and Robotouille show that MemPlan improves task completion and step efficiency over language-only and PDDL-aware baselines, while substantially reducing online token cost compared with LLM-planning baselines such as ReAct. The same fine-tuned interface is also reused across TextWorld task types without task-specific fine-tuning. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/tewiSong/MemPlan.
title: MemPlan: Memory-Conditioned PDDL Planning for Partially Observable Text Environments
title_translated: MemPlan：面向部分可观测文本环境的记忆条件化PDDL规划
summary_translated: 大语言模型代理在语言交互方面具有灵活性，但将其用作长周期规划器成本高且容易产生幻觉或无效动作。本文为大语言模型赋予另一种角色：语言与符号规划之间的受控桥梁。我们提出MemPlan，一种面向部分可观测交互式文本环境的记忆条件化PDDL规划框架。MemPlan保持PDDL领域固定，每一步从解析的观测结果、候选假设和交互记忆中重构PDDL问题。正向图记忆为缺失对象、位置或条件的候选假设分配基于相关性的动作成本，引导规划器趋向更合理的检查路径；负向记忆记录已被执行否定的假设，并将其编译为排除约束，防止重复尝试已被反馈证伪的候选。一个统一的模式条件化语言-符号接口，通过离线监督微调训练，通过观测到事实的解析和符号动作到命令的对齐，连接文本环境与规划循环。在TextWorld、ALFWorld和Robotouille上的实验表明，MemPlan在任务完成率和步骤效率上优于仅语言和PDDL感知的基线，同时相比如ReAct等LLM规划基线显著降低了在线token消耗。相同的微调接口也可在不进行任务特定微调的情况下跨TextWorld不同任务类型复用。我们的代码和数据可在https://github.com/tewiSong/MemPlan获取。

summary: The massively multilingual translation systems that now include Sicilian learned it from noisy, non-standardised web text. To obtain better translation quality, we redevelop the small neural machine translation (NMT) system that Wdowiak customized for Sicilian. We rebuild on maintained software the extraction of the parallel text from the PDFs of the bilingual journal Arba Sicula, whose sentences are aligned by a language-agnostic sentence encoder with thresholds tuned against an existing hand alignment and then filtered for the typical errors of automatic alignment. Furthermore, the tokenization and the desinence-biased subword segmentation of the original system are ported to a Perl-free implementation, and all the results are measured on a frozen test set drawn from the journal. We compare small Transformers trained from scratch with the pretrained NLLB model adapted by low-rank fine-tuning, in both directions and with Italian as a closely related bridge language, and we adapt to the pretrained model the reverse-training recipe of the original system, i.e., a stage on forward-scored back-translations of the web Sicilian followed by a stage on the curated literary text. The pretrained model is by far the better of the two, and the staged training improves the translation into Sicilian more than the translation from it. On the test set of the original system, and in the tokenized space in which it was scored, the staged model with a larger adapter and more back-translations is above the reverse-training recipe in the directions that involve English and below it between Sicilian and Italian. Yet, a multilingual adapter degrades the directions on which it was not trained, which limits its use as a general multilingual model.
title: Climbing the Ladder: Automating Data Pipelines and Reproducing Baselines in Low-Resource Settings
title_translated: 攀登阶梯：在低资源环境下自动化数据管道并复现基线
summary_translated: 如今包含西西里语的海量多语言翻译系统是从噪声大、非标准化的网络文本中学来的。为了获得更好的翻译质量，我们重新开发了Wdowiak为西西里语定制的小型神经机器翻译（NMT）系统。我们在维护良好的软件基础上，从双语期刊《Arba Sicula》的PDF中提取平行文本，该期刊句子通过语言无关的句子编码器对齐，阈值基于已有手工对齐进行调优，随后过滤自动对齐的典型错误。此外，原系统的分词和偏向词尾的子词分割被移植到无需Perl的实现中，所有结果均在来自该期刊的冻结测试集上测量。我们比较了从头训练的小型Transformer与通过低秩微调适配的预训练NLLB模型，双向进行，并以意大利语作为密切相关的桥梁语言；同时，我们还将原系统反向训练方案适配到预训练模型，即先在网页西西里语的前向评分回译阶段训练，再在精心筛选的文学文本阶段训练。预训练模型远优于另一模型，分阶段训练在向西西里语翻译方面提升幅度大于从西西里语翻译。在原系统测试集上，且在原系统评分所用的分词空间中，采用更大适配器和更多回译的分阶段模型在涉及英语的方向上优于反向训练方案，但在西西里语与意大利语之间则低于该方案。然而，多语言适配器在未训练方向上表现下降，限制其作为通用多语言模型的使用。

summary: Hallucinated citations make it harder to trace sources and verify the evidence behind scientific claims. Detecting them is difficult because bibliographic records can be incomplete or differ across source types and publication versions. A plausible match alone neither validates the citation nor establishes its underlying source. We introduce CiteResolve, a benchmark of 423 real-world hallucinated citations annotated for source recoverability. We further propose CiteAnchor, a source-aware grounding framework that adapts retrieval and field-level verification to each source type and separately determines citation validity and whether a unique source can be recovered. On an existing detection benchmark, CiteAnchor achieves 0.841 F1 with GPT-5.6 Luna and 0.784 with an open-weight backbone, outperforming the baseline with the same backbones by 7.9 and 36.8 points. On CiteResolve, it achieves 74.7% and 70.7% end-to-end task success, outperforming the corresponding web search baselines by 16.3 and 65.3 percentage points. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/oldwizard7/CiteANCHOR_code.
title: CiteAnchor: Source-Aware Grounding for Hallucinated Citation Detection and Resolution
title_translated: CiteAnchor：面向幻觉引用检测与修复的源感知定位
summary_translated: 幻觉引用使得追踪来源和验证科学主张背后的证据更加困难。检测它们很困难，因为参考文献记录可能不完整，或在不同来源类型和出版版本间存在差异。仅有一个合理匹配并不能验证引用，也无法确定其底层来源。我们引入CiteResolve，一个包含423个真实世界幻觉引用的基准，标注了源可恢复性。我们进一步提出CiteAnchor，一种源感知定位框架，根据每种来源类型分别调整检索和字段级验证，并独立判断引用的有效性及是否能唯一恢复来源。在现有检测基准上，CiteAnchor使用GPT-5.6 Luna达到0.841 F1，使用开源骨干模型达到0.784，分别比相同骨干基线高出7.9和36.8分。在CiteResolve上，它分别达到74.7%和70.7%的端到端任务成功率，比对应网络搜索基线高出16.3和65.3个百分点。我们的代码和数据可在https://github.com/oldwizard7/CiteANCHOR_code获取。

summary: LLMs are increasingly consulted for moral judgment. We aim to improve performance on such tasks by rewarding good arguments, on the premise that arguing well increases the likelihood of judging well. We train a reinforcement learning policy initialized from a state-of-the-art language model in a self-judged tournament with masked thinking: the generated arguments are judged pairwise on argument quality by the policy itself. As an empirical basis, we extract authentic dilemmas from classic novels, using a logic solver to verify that each constitutes a conflict. We show that our judge rates argument quality like human annotators, and the policy then adopts the language register that it rewards. Testing on the external benchmarks MoralChoice, ELEPHANT, and MORABLES, we find that the policy becomes more decisive and invariant to the order in which options are presented, but sycophancy and reframing remain a challenge to validity. Two ablation studies with synthetic dilemmas and unmasked thinking match the reordering gains, but show a weaker register shift and higher sycophancy. We conclude that consistency is not validity: consistency under reordering can be optimized without improving the moral judgment it is meant to signal.
title: Consistency Is Not Validity: Self-Rewarded Moral Argumentation Makes Language Models Decisive but Pliable
title_translated: 一致性不等于有效性：自我奖励的道德论证使语言模型更具决断力但易受操控
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于道德判断任务。我们旨在通过奖励高质量的论证来提升模型在这些任务上的表现，前提是良好的论证有助于做出更好的判断。我们在一个带有掩码思维的自评锦标赛中，使用从先进语言模型初始化的强化学习策略进行训练：生成的论证由策略自身以成对方式评估其论证质量。作为实证基础，我们从经典小说中提取真实的道德困境，并使用逻辑求解器验证每个困境均构成冲突。结果表明，我们的评判标准与人类标注者一致，且策略随后采用了其自身所奖励的语言风格。在外部基准测试MoralChoice、ELEPHANT和MORABLES上，我们发现策略变得更加决断且对选项呈现顺序不敏感，但奉承行为和重新表述仍是影响有效性的挑战。两项消融实验分别使用合成困境和非掩码思维，匹配了重排带来的收益，但显示出较弱的语言风格转变和更高的奉承倾向。结论是：一致性不等于有效性——在选项重排下的一致性可以被优化，而无需真正提升其所应指示的道德判断能力。

summary: Training Arabic large language models faces challenges from noisy web data, dialectal variation, and the high cost of continual pretraining (CPT). We introduce AQL-Lite (AQL: Arabic Quality Language), a time- and resource-efficient framework for adapting a multilingual LLM to Modern Standard Arabic (MSA). AQL-Lite couples a quality-first curation pipeline (structural cleaning, heuristic and model-based filtering, MSA selection, and deduplication) with a partial-parameter CPT recipe that trains RS-LoRA adapters across the network together with the last eight transformer blocks and the embedding matrix, under layer-wise learning rates. At a matched 1B-token budget, CPT on AQL-curated data raises a four-benchmark Arabic mean by 3.51 points over CPT on raw web text, which yields no gain over the base model. In a controlled 5B-token comparison, AQL-Lite recovers 94% of the gain of full-parameter CPT (mean 73.19 vs. 73.58) in 52% of the wall-clock time and outperforms adapter-only baselines on every benchmark, and a component ablation shows that adapters, unfrozen blocks, and embedding training each contribute. Scaled to 40B MSA tokens and instruction-tuned on one million examples, the resulting 12B model scores 75.3 on the seven-benchmark Open Arabic LLM Leaderboard v2 (OALL v2) suite. These results suggest that partial-parameter CPT on a carefully curated corpus is a practical route to efficient MSA adaptation.
title: AQL-Lite: Enabling Efficient Knowledge Acquisition for Arabic LLMs via Data-Centric Continual Pretraining
title_translated: AQL-Lite：通过数据驱动的持续预训练实现阿拉伯语大模型高效知识获取
summary_translated: 训练阿拉伯语大语言模型面临网络数据噪声、方言差异以及持续预训练（CPT）成本高昂等挑战。我们提出AQL-Lite（AQL：阿拉伯语质量语言），一种时间与资源高效的框架，用于将多语言大模型适配至现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）。AQL-Lite结合了以质量为先的数据清洗流程（结构清理、启发式与模型过滤、MSA选择、去重）与部分参数持续预训练方案，该方案在分层学习率下联合训练RS-LoRA适配器、最后八个Transformer块及嵌入矩阵。在匹配10亿token预算的情况下，基于AQL筛选数据的CPT相比原始网络文本的CPT，使阿拉伯语四项基准平均得分提升3.51分，而后者相较于基线模型无提升。在受控的50亿token对比实验中，AQL-Lite在52%的时钟时间内恢复了全参数CPT 94%的增益（平均得分73.19 vs. 73.58），并在所有基准上优于仅使用适配器的基线模型；组件消融分析显示，适配器、未冻结块和嵌入训练各自均有贡献。扩展至400亿MSA token并使用一百万条指令微调后，最终的12B模型在七项基准的Open Arabic LLM Leaderboard v2（OALL v2）套件中得分达到75.3。这些结果表明，在精心筛选语料库上进行部分参数持续预训练，是实现高效MSA适配的可行路径。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have accelerated research on low-resource and multilingual NLP, but their effectiveness in creating an equitable landscape remains unmapped. We analyze 1,158 peer-reviewed open-access papers published between 2020 and 2025, examining research attention to low-resource languages (LRLs) and representation across language and speaker populations. To assess linguistic inclusion beyond publication counts, we introduce the Linguistic Inclusion Framework (LIF), a multidimensional framework that measures linguistic inclusion in four dimensions: research growth, representation expansion, representation continuity, and distributional equity. While annual publications grew from 52 to 415, a 5.4X increase in their ACL Anthology publication share, this growth largely concentrated on represented languages rather than expanding coverage of underrepresented languages. Further analysis shows that languages spoken in Asia account for 64.1% of speakers across LRLs we analyze but receive only 46.7% of the language representation share (0.7X their proportional share), while European languages receive 5.3X their proportional share. At the country level, linguistically diverse regions such as sub-Saharan Africa and Southeast Asia show the lowest language coverage ratios. Applying the framework at the continental level, we find that no region scores well on all four dimensions, showing that research growth alone is not a reliable metric of progress toward equitable and inclusive language technology\footnote{We will release all collected and annotated data for research purposes}.
title: Measuring Research Progress and Linguistic Inclusion in Low-Resource Languages
title_translated: 衡量低资源语言研究进展与语言包容性
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）加速了低资源与多语言自然语言处理的研究，但其在构建公平语言生态方面的实际效果尚未被系统评估。我们分析了2020至2025年间发表的1,158篇同行评审的开放获取论文，考察了对低资源语言（LRLs）的研究关注度及其在语言与说话人群体中的代表性。为超越单纯出版数量的评估，我们提出了语言包容性框架（LIF），一个包含四个维度的多维评估体系：研究增长、代表性扩展、代表性连续性与分布公平性。尽管年度论文数量从52篇增至415篇，ACL文集中的占比增长5.4倍，但这种增长主要集中在已有代表性的语言，而非拓展对欠代表语言的覆盖。进一步分析显示，亚洲语言在我们分析的低资源语言中占64.1%的使用者比例，却仅获得46.7%的语言代表性份额（仅为比例份额的0.7倍），而欧洲语言则获得5.3倍于其比例份额的代表性。在国家层面，语言多样性高的地区如撒哈拉以南非洲和东南亚表现出最低的语言覆盖率比率。在大陆层面应用该框架发现，没有任何一个区域在四个维度上均表现良好，表明仅研究增长不足以可靠衡量向公平包容语言技术迈进的进展。【我们将公开所有收集与标注的数据供研究使用】

summary: Model fusion aims to integrate the capabilities of multi-expert models into a single model. Existing evaluations offer limited coverage of reasoning with long chains of thought and tool use, while strong average performance can mask substantial losses in individual expert capabilities. We introduce FusionEval, a benchmark that provides controlled expert pools, integrates fusion methods with and without additional training, and offers a unified evaluation suite. The pools contain domain experts independently trained from Qwen3 and Llama base models across math, code, science, instruction following, and tool use. The suite evaluates capability retention and computational cost on eight public benchmarks under comparable data access rules, reporting normalized average and worst performance, runtime, and peak GPU memory usage. Extensive experiments show that training-free methods preserve reasoning performance but substantially degrade tool use at both model scales. In contrast, MOPD preserves tool use and achieves a more balanced capability profile, but requires additional data preparation, inference, and training. Jointly retaining reasoning, instruction following, and tool use at low computational cost remains a challenge. We hope FusionEval supports future research on efficient model fusion that jointly preserves expert capabilities. Our code is available at https://github.com/Baicaihaochi/FusionEval_Benchmark.
title: FusionEval: Benchmarking Model Fusion for Large Language Models
title_translated: FusionEval：大语言模型模型融合的基准评测
summary_translated: 模型融合旨在将多专家模型的能力整合到单一模型中。现有评估在长链推理与工具使用方面覆盖有限，而平均性能优异可能掩盖个别专家能力的显著损失。我们提出FusionEval，一个提供受控专家池、集成有无额外训练的融合方法，并具备统一评估套件的基准。专家池包含独立训练的Qwen3和Llama基础模型在数学、代码、科学、指令遵循和工具使用等领域的专家。评估套件在八项公开基准上，在相同数据访问规则下评估能力保留程度与计算成本，报告归一化后的平均与最差性能、运行时间及峰值GPU内存使用量。大量实验表明，无需训练的方法能保持推理性能，但在两个模型规模下均严重损害工具使用能力。相比之下，MOPD方法保留了工具使用能力并实现了更均衡的能力分布，但需要额外的数据准备、推理与训练。在低计算成本下同时保留推理、指令遵循与工具使用能力仍是一大挑战。我们希望FusionEval能推动未来高效模型融合研究，实现专家能力的共同保留。代码已开源：https://github.com/Baicaihaochi/FusionEval_Benchmark。

summary: Many Indian banks serve customers through FAQ pages and scripted chatbots. Assistants based on language models could respond faster and carry out requests such as blocking a card, but only if they give correct information and follow the bank's rules. These rules prescribe a procedure, a set of required steps, such as obtaining a closure quote before closing a deposit. Adapting models to this domain requires measuring how well they follow the procedure, before and after training. Benchmarks usually judge only the records left at the end of a conversation. Many required steps, however, leave the records unchanged, so an assistant that skips them can still be judged successful. We present TauIndianBankBench, an action-oriented benchmark of 1,000 Indian retail-banking tasks where an assistant helps a simulated customer. Besides the final records, it checks that the assistant took every required step and made no unrequested change. For every model, 6.5-12.0% of sessions are judged successful when only the final records are checked, although the assistant skipped a required step or made an unrequested change. Scoring both procedure and outcome shows more accurately how well language models perform in Indian retail banking.
title: TauIndianBankBench: Procedure-Aware, Action-Oriented Evaluation of Tool-Using Conversational Agents

title_translated: TauIndianBankBench：面向工具使用对话智能体的程序感知、行动导向评估
summary_translated: 许多印度银行通过FAQ页面和脚本化聊天机器人服务客户。基于语言模型的助手可更快响应并执行如挂失卡片等请求，但前提是必须提供正确信息并遵守银行规则。这些规则规定了特定流程，即一系列必要步骤，例如在关闭存款账户前需获取结清证明。将模型适配至该领域需要衡量其在训练前后对流程的遵循程度。现有基准通常仅评估对话结束时的记录。然而，许多必要步骤不会改变记录，因此即使跳过这些步骤，助手仍可能被判定为成功。我们提出TauIndianBankBench，一个包含1,000个印度零售银行业务任务的行动导向基准，其中助手协助模拟客户完成任务。除了最终记录外，该基准还检查助手是否执行了每一个必要步骤，且未进行任何未经请求的更改。对于每个模型，仅检查最终记录时，6.5%-12.0%的会话被判定为成功，尽管助手跳过了必要步骤或进行了未经授权的变更。同时评估流程与结果能更准确反映语言模型在印度零售银行场景中的实际表现。

summary: Artificial intelligence (AI), as a decision-support aid, provides new tools for studying history effectively using multimodal data, including text, images, and audio. We present, to our knowledge, the first digital assistant named Lighthouse--commonly called a chatbot--for exploring the Civil Rights period of the United States using data from South Carolina. From an AI perspective, the system's novelty lies in its guiding design principles of (a) focusing on trustworthiness of content and (b) by modeling and reducing potential harm to users from generated answers. It implements these with a neuro-symbolic approach that combines neural learning through a large language model (LLM) with rule-based symbolic solving, balancing risk of answers with generality of coverage. We evaluate Lighthouse with both factual objective questions that admit a single acceptable answer as well as subjective questions. For the latter, a dataset of subjective question-answer pairs (QAs) is created by discovering a "gold standard" by aggregating answers from independent experts. Lighthouse has access to over 18k primary sources from a range of collections and can be easily extended.
title: Lighthouse: On Building a Trustworthy Digital Assistant for Exploring History with Civil Rights Archives
title_translated: Lighthouse：构建一个值得信赖的数字助手以探索民权档案中的历史
summary_translated: 人工智能（AI）作为决策支持工具，为利用包括文本、图像和音频在内的多模态数据有效研究历史提供了新方法。我们提出，据我们所知，首个名为Lighthouse的数字助手——通常称为聊天机器人——用于通过南卡罗来纳州的数据探索美国民权时期的历史。从AI角度来看，该系统的新颖之处在于其指导性设计原则：(a) 关注内容的可信度；(b) 通过建模并减少生成答案对用户可能造成的潜在伤害。它采用神经符号方法，将大型语言模型（LLM）的神经学习与基于规则的符号求解相结合，在答案风险与覆盖广度之间取得平衡。我们使用事实性客观问题（可接受单一正确答案）以及主观问题对Lighthouse进行评估。对于后者，通过聚合独立专家的答案创建了一个主观问答对数据集作为“黄金标准”。Lighthouse可访问超过18,000份来自多个馆藏的一手资料，并且易于扩展。

summary: Nonlinear recurrent networks remain useful for streaming sequence modeling, yet gated cell design is still dominated by LSTM and GRU. We study whether recurrent computation can be reallocated away from gate transforms and toward candidate generation. We propose baseVultra, a compact recurrent cell that concentrates the dense recurrent budget on a single H x H candidate-generation matrix, while replacing recurrent gate matrices with O(H) diagonal interactions. The candidate update combines this dense branch with two low-rank auxiliary branches, an EMA cache, and learnable output blending; the gates additionally receive lightweight second-order access to h_{t-2} through diagonal terms. On TinyShakespeare character-level language modeling, baseVultra achieves a validation loss of 1.594 in the compact one-layer 200K setting, compared with 1.604 for a parameter-matched LSTM and 1.616 for a parameter-matched GRU, while its dense recurrent matrix-vector computation is about 54% of GRU under matched hidden size for this configuration. On text8, a roughly 45x larger benchmark, baseVultra is competitive with full-gate cells (1.854 bpc vs. 1.849 for GRU and 1.837 for LSTM). On formal-language probes, the largest gains appear under constrained hidden-state capacity (0.991 vs. 0.761 GRU and 0.691 LSTM OOD2 accuracy on Counter at H=16) and vanish as hidden size grows. These results characterize where and when candidate-focused recurrent capacity allocation helps: the benefit is concentrated in compact regimes, while full-gate cells remain competitive at scale.
title: baseVultra: Compact Nonlinear Recurrence with Reallocated Capacity
