title_translated: baseVultra：具有重新分配容量的紧凑非线性递归结构
summary_translated: 非线性递归网络在流式序列建模中仍具实用性，但门控单元设计仍主要由LSTM和GRU主导。我们研究是否可以将递归计算从门控变换转移到候选生成上。我们提出了baseVultra，一种紧凑的递归单元，将密集递归预算集中于单一H×H的候选生成矩阵，同时用O(H)的对角交互替代递归门矩阵。候选更新结合了这一密集分支与两个低秩辅助分支、EMA缓存以及可学习的输出融合；门控还通过对角项获得轻量级的二阶h_{t-2}访问。在TinyShakespeare字符级语言建模任务中，baseVultra在单层20万参数设置下达到1.594的验证损失，优于参数匹配的LSTM（1.604）和GRU（1.616），且其密集递归矩阵向量运算量约为相同隐藏尺寸下GRU的54%。在更大的text8基准测试（约45倍大）中，baseVultra与全门控单元表现相当（1.854 bpc vs. GRU 1.849 和 LSTM 1.837）。在形式语言探测任务中，最大收益出现在受限隐藏状态容量下（Counter任务在H=16时，baseVultra OOD2准确率为0.991，GRU为0.761，LSTM为0.691），随着隐藏尺寸增大，优势消失。这些结果揭示了候选聚焦递归容量分配的适用场景：在紧凑配置中受益显著，而全门控单元在大规模下仍具竞争力。

summary: Test-time scaling has emerged as a key inference strategy for reasoning models, where a model generates a large number of candidate solutions in the hope of finding at least one correct solution. Running all candidate solutions to completion can be computationally demanding, so recent work prunes the candidate pool after generating only a short prefix, committing further computation only to the surviving candidates. Existing pruning strategies divide broadly into two categories: Quality-based methods assign a score to each partial solution and discard those predicted to ultimately lead to an incorrect final solution, while diversity-based methods select partial solutions that follow different reasoning trajectories and are therefore likely to cover different final solutions. The tension between these two objectives is an instance of exploration versus exploitation, yet little to no prior work on pruning exposes this trade-off directly, let alone optimizes it. In this paper, we introduce a pruning procedure that addresses this trade-off directly by optimizing pass@$k$ over the selected solution pool. In particular, it chooses the pool to maximize the probability that at least one of its partial solutions, when continued to completion, yields a correct answer. Because this objective simultaneously rewards high-quality partial solutions and penalizes redundancy among them, quality and diversity are naturally balanced by the criterion itself rather than through separate ad-hoc design choices. On eight open-weight reasoning models, our method outperforms existing quality-based and diversity-based pruning strategies. The gains are particularly pronounced when the pruning procedure keeps a moderate number of partial solutions for continued generation, highlighting the value of directly balancing quality and diversity during pruning.
title: Direct Pass@$k$ Optimization for Thought Pruning: Balancing Quality and Diversity in Test-Time Reasoning
title_translated: 直接优化Pass@$k$以实现思维剪枝：在测试时推理中平衡质量与多样性
summary_translated: 测试时缩放已成为推理模型的关键推理策略，即模型生成大量候选解，以期至少找到一个正确解。完整运行所有候选解计算成本高昂，因此近期工作在仅生成短前缀后即对候选池进行剪枝，仅对留存候选继续投入计算。现有剪枝策略大致分为两类：基于质量的方法为每个部分解分配分数，丢弃那些预测最终会导致错误答案的解；基于多样性的方法则选择遵循不同推理路径的部分解，从而更可能覆盖不同的最终解。这两项目标之间的张力是探索与利用的体现，然而此前极少有剪枝研究直接暴露这一权衡，更不用说对其进行优化。本文引入一种直接通过优化所选解池的Pass@$k$来解决该权衡的剪枝过程。具体而言，它选择解池以最大化至少一个部分解在完成后的正确答案概率。由于该目标同时奖励高质量的部分解并惩罚它们之间的冗余，质量与多样性自然由准则本身平衡，无需额外的人工设计。在八种开放权重推理模型上，我们的方法优于现有的基于质量与基于多样性的剪枝策略。当剪枝过程保留适度数量的部分解以继续生成时，提升尤为显著，凸显了在剪枝过程中直接平衡质量与多样性的价值。

summary: Wrong automatic routing of an IT support ticket can cost more than human triage. We evaluate cost-aware abstention as an offline, cost-conditional readiness assessment: select a routing policy on calibration data under explicit costs, then evaluate that frozen policy once on held-out test data. On a public 47,837-ticket, eight-class corpus, we compare four trained non-LLM classifiers with four large language models under zero- and few-shot prompting. Under the illustrative cost model (c_ok, c_triage, c_wrong) = (0, 1, 5), TF-IDF with logistic regression and a threshold of 0.60 selected on calibration reduces test cost from 0.763 to 0.472, a 38.1% relative reduction (paired ratio-bootstrap 95% CI [35.7%, 40.4%]), while lowering wrong routes from 15.3% to 3.5%. Frozen calibration-selected policies also beat both always-route and always-defer on held-out test data in 14 of 16 settings in a post-hoc cost-parameter analysis. The strongest prompted configuration reaches 0.477 accuracy on a stratified 1,000-ticket test subset, versus 0.879 for fine-tuned DistilBERT on the same tickets. Isotonic lowers expected calibration error without reliably improving discrimination: GPT-4o-mini few-shot has one confidence value before and after recalibration and correctness AUROC 0.500. We therefore report correctness AUROC and tie-aware risk-coverage area alongside ECE. At the analytically derived break-even probability 0.80, seven prompted configurations defer all tickets; Haiku few-shot routes only 19/1,000. An LLM-only agreement control and margin/entropy rejection baselines further separate calibration from discrimination. The findings are scoped to this dataset, prompt design, model endpoints, and illustrative costs; the work is an evaluation framework, not a new abstention algorithm or universal deployment certification.
title: Cost-Aware Abstention for LLM-Based IT Ticket Classification

title_translated: 面向LLM的IT工单分类的成本感知拒答机制
summary_translated: 错误的自动路由IT支持工单成本可能高于人工处理。我们评估成本感知拒答作为一种离线、成本条件下的就绪度评估：在校准数据上根据显式成本选择路由策略，然后在保留的测试数据上一次性评估该冻结策略。在一个包含47,837个工单、八类的公开语料库上，我们将四种训练好的非LLM分类器与四种大型语言模型在零样本和少样本提示下进行比较。在示例成本模型（c_ok, c_triage, c_wrong）= (0, 1, 5) 下，TF-IDF结合逻辑回归并在校准数据上设定0.60阈值，使测试成本从0.763降至0.472，相对降低38.1%（配对比率-bootstrap 95%置信区间[35.7%, 40.4%]），同时将错误路由率从15.3%降至3.5%。在事后成本参数分析中，冻结的校准选择策略在16个设置中的14个上优于始终路由和始终拒答。最强提示配置在分层的1,000个工单测试子集上达到0.477准确率，而微调的DistilBERT在同一数据上为0.879。等距校准降低了期望校准误差，但未可靠提升判别能力：GPT-4o-mini少样本提示在再校准前后仅有一次置信度值，正确性AUROC为0.500。因此我们报告正确性AUROC和考虑关联风险覆盖面积，以及ECE。在理论推导的临界概率0.80处，七种提示配置全部拒答所有工单；Haiku少样本仅路由19/1,000。仅LLM的协议控制和边际/熵拒绝基线进一步区分了校准与判别。研究发现局限于该数据集、提示设计、模型端点和示例成本；本工作是一个评估框架，而非新的拒答算法或通用部署认证。

summary: \emph{Continuous-space} attacks find prompts that trigger malicious behaviors, such as overthinking, in black-box LLMs by sampling or optimizing over a low-dimensional Gaussian latent space and decoding it to text through a \emph{random mapping} and nearest-token lookup. Because the random mapping is not learned from language, its prompts can be highly unnatural, and as such easily detectable through input guardrails, and the risk estimates they yield are not grounded in natural prompts. In this paper, we demonstrate that the same continuous latent-space framework can be coupled directly to a learned generative distribution over language, a continuous diffusion language model (dLLM), which removes the artificial random mapping while preserving the standard-Gaussian latent formulation and the downstream sampling or optimization procedure. We evaluate this approach under two settings: sampling-based estimation using \emph{RareTrap} and optimization-based search using \emph{ThinkTrap}. We find that character-level perplexity drops from $10^3$--$10^7$ to 3--5 in RareTrap and from 20--28 to 4.3--5.4 in ThinkTrap. We also find that model risk estimates can differ by an order of magnitude across the two mappings.
title: Diffusion Language Models for Perplexity-Aware Black-Box Attacks
title_translated: 用于困惑度感知黑盒攻击的扩散语言模型
summary_translated: 连续空间攻击通过在低维高斯隐空间中采样或优化，并通过随机映射和最近词查找解码为文本，来寻找触发黑盒LLM恶意行为（如过度思考）的提示。由于随机映射未从语言中学习，其提示往往极不自然，极易被输入防护机制检测，且由此产生的风险估计缺乏自然提示的基础。本文证明，相同的连续隐空间框架可直接与语言上的学习生成分布结合，即连续扩散语言模型（dLLM），从而消除人为的随机映射，同时保留标准高斯隐空间形式和下游采样或优化流程。我们在两种设置下评估该方法：基于采样的估计使用RareTrap，基于优化的搜索使用ThinkTrap。我们发现，在RareTrap中，字符级困惑度从10³–10⁷降至3–5；在ThinkTrap中，从20–28降至4.3–5.4。我们还发现，两种映射下的模型风险估计可相差一个数量级。

summary: Text-to-speech (TTS) is usually evaluated by transcribing its output with an automatic speech recognition (ASR) system, so the word error rate also counts recognizer errors. We measure these errors on human recordings of the test sentences. On LibriSpeech and FLEURS, the evaluation recognizer misses 33-67% of very rare words even in human speech, and all three recognizers miss 22-42%. Checking every word with two more recognizer families lowers the apparent TTS error on words that at least one recognizer hears two- to three-fold (very rare LibriSpeech words: from 10-13% to 3-5%), yet very rare words remain the hardest. Ignoring words the recognizer misses in human speech is biased: the other recognizers find TTS errors far more often on these words (4-6% vs. 0.2-0.3%) and overturn about half of the errors this mask keeps. As half of the remaining adjudicated errors may be spelling variants, a listening test is needed.
title: Measuring the Verifier's Floor: How Much Apparent Rare-Word Text-to-Speech Error Is ASR Error?
title_translated: 衡量验证者的下限：有多少看似罕见词的文本转语音错误其实是ASR错误？
summary_translated: 文本转语音（TTS）通常通过自动语音识别（ASR）系统对输出进行转录来评估，因此词错误率也包含了识别器的错误。我们在人类录制的测试语句上测量这些错误。在LibriSpeech和FLEURS数据集上，评估用的识别器即使在人类语音中也会遗漏33%-67%的极罕见词汇，且三个识别器均遗漏22%-42%。使用另外两个识别器家族检查每个词，可使看似TTS错误的罕见词错误率降低两到三倍（极罕见LibriSpeech词：从10%-13%降至3%-5%），但极罕见词仍是最难处理的。忽略识别器在人类语音中遗漏的词存在偏差：其他识别器在这些词上发现TTS错误的频率远高于此（4%-6% vs. 0.2%-0.3%），并推翻了约一半被该掩码保留的错误。由于剩余已裁定错误中约一半可能是拼写变体，因此需要进行听觉测试。

summary: Systems that aim to help a user engage with viewpoints other than their own have to decide how different those viewpoints should be. Viewpoints are mainly represented on a scalar scale, too coarse to distinguish viewpoints that disagree with the user about different things. We introduce a selection policy in which a bandit sets how far viewpoints may sit from the user, and the policy selects the most novel viewpoint within that bound. We vary only its stance encoder, comparing a scalar score with Perspectivized Stance Vectors, which break a position into separate stances on concepts. We integrate it inside a dialog system and run a between-subjects study (N=63). Concept-level stance produces more varied exposure sequences and broader coverage of the topic's positions, but does not change how deeply users justify viewpoints or how accurately they reconstruct them. Finally, we analyze user--viewpoint relations at the concept level, showing that users reconstruct a viewpoint least accurately on concepts that one side took no position on, rather than on concepts where the two disagreed. Our findings open up opportunities for dialog systems that support engagement with alternative viewpoints by acting on which concepts a user and a viewpoint disagree on, rather than on distance alone.
title: How Different, or Different How? Stance Granularity in Viewpoint Selection for Dialog Systems that Engage Users with Alternative Views
title_translated: 有多不同，或如何不同？对话系统中观点选择的立场粒度研究
summary_translated: 旨在帮助用户接触与其自身观点不同的系统的对话系统，必须决定这些观点应有多“不同”。目前观点主要以标量尺度表示，过于粗糙，无法区分在不同方面与用户相左的观点。我们提出一种选择策略，其中强化学习中的“老虎机”机制设定观点与用户之间的距离范围，而策略则在该范围内选择最新颖的观点。我们仅改变其立场编码器，将标量评分与“视角化立场向量”进行对比，后者将立场分解为在各个概念上的独立立场。我们将该方法集成至对话系统，并开展一项被试间实验（N=63）。结果显示，概念级立场能产生更丰富的观点暴露序列并覆盖更广泛的观点范围，但并未改变用户论证观点的深度或重构观点的准确性。最后，我们从概念层面分析用户与观点的关系，发现用户在某一方未表态的概念上重构观点最不准确，而非在双方存在分歧的概念上。我们的研究为对话系统支持用户接触替代观点提供了新思路，即基于用户与观点在哪些概念上存在分歧，而非仅依赖距离。

summary: Given an unseen graph, a start node, $s$, and an end node, $t$, can a language model generate the shortest path from $s$ to $t$? Prior work has found that models fail to learn this task as the graphs scale. We show that this failure has two causes: the supervision signal and the tokenization. First, we theoretically establish and empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of multi-token prediction (MTP), and show that the benefits of MTP are topologically agnostic. Second, we introduce alternative tokenizations and show that the two causes are orthogonal. Using these methods, we break through the scaling wall observed by prior work, consistently and stably learning to solve the task at scales far beyond previous limits.
title: Multi-Token Prediction and Alternative Tokenization Improve Learning Latent Multi-Hop Graph Search at Scale

title_translated: 多标记预测与替代分词提升大规模潜在多跳图搜索的学习能力
summary_translated: 面对一个未见过的图、起始节点s和目标节点t，语言模型能否生成从s到t的最短路径？先前研究发现，随着图规模增大，模型难以学习该任务。我们揭示这一失败有两个原因：监督信号和分词方式。首先，我们从理论上建立并实证证明了多标记预测（MTP）的有效性，且其优势具有拓扑无关性。其次，我们引入替代分词方法，并表明这两个因素是正交的。结合这两种方法，我们突破了先前研究观察到的扩展瓶颈，在远超以往极限的规模上稳定、持续地学习解决该任务。

summary: Vector quantization (VQ), in particular lattice-based methods, offer strong rate-distortion trade-offs for low-bit large language models (LLMs), yet their behavior under quantization-aware training (VQ-QAT) remains poorly understood. We scale lattice VQ-QAT to billion-parameter LLMs and multi-billion-token training regimes, and introduce SQuAT, a shape-gain VQ-QAT approach trained with a separate straight-through estimator (STE) for the shape and gain. SQuAT decomposes weights into direction and magnitude: normalized directions are quantized using an $E_8$-derived spherical codebook, while gains are quantized independently with low-bit scalar quantizers. We show that, unlike a standard STE applied to the full quantizer, which ignores the shape-gain structure, these separate STEs induce tangent-space updates for directions, yielding an implicit form of spherical (Riemannian) optimization. To enable scalability, we develop a distributed exact nearest-neighbor assignment scheme, in which workers quantize disjoint weight blocks and communicate only discrete indices, reducing VQ-QAT training time by 12.8$\times$ and allowing us to scale it to 10B tokens. Across instruction-tuned LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B, Qwen3-4B, and base Qwen3-1.7B, SQuAT consistently outperforms standard VQ-QAT STE under identical quantizers and initialization, and achieves SOTA VQ-QAT accuracy.
title: SQuAT: Spherical Lattice Vector Quantization-Aware Training
authors: Tycho F. A. van der Ouderaa
title_translated: SQuAT：球形格量化感知训练
summary_translated: 向量量化（VQ），尤其是基于格的方法，为低比特大语言模型（LLMs）提供了优异的率失真权衡，但其在量化感知训练（VQ-QAT）下的行为仍不清晰。我们将基于格的VQ-QAT扩展至十亿参数级别的LLMs及数十亿token的训练场景，提出SQuAT——一种形状-增益分离的VQ-QAT方法，采用独立的直通估计器（STE）分别处理形状和增益。SQuAT将权重分解为方向与幅度：归一化方向使用基于E₈的球形码本进行量化，而增益则独立使用低比特标量量化器进行量化。我们证明，与直接应用于整个量化器的标准STE不同，这种分离的STE会诱导方向的切空间更新，从而实现隐式的球面（黎曼）优化。为实现可扩展性，我们开发了一种分布式精确最近邻分配方案，各工作节点量化互不重叠的权重块，仅交换离散索引，使VQ-QAT训练时间减少12.8倍，并成功将其扩展至100亿token。在指令微调的LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B、Qwen3-4B和基础版Qwen3-1.7B模型上，SQuAT在相同量化器和初始化条件下始终优于标准VQ-QAT STE，并达到当前最优的VQ-QAT精度。

summary: Visual document understanding is essential for acquiring knowledge from visually rich documents and is attracting growing research interest. Existing surveys emphasize architectures or technical approaches, with limited attention to how task bottlenecks shape technical choices and research priorities. We present a task-centric survey that decomposes long-document visual question answering (VQA) into four components: document parsing, evidence organization and retrieval, generator organization and learning, and evaluation. For each, we develop a fine-grained taxonomy and trace motivations, technical responses, and cross-component connections. We focus on explicit retrieval while covering direct reading. Our temporal analysis traces expanding priorities from multimodal content understanding to sufficient, high-fidelity evidence acquisition and sustained evidence management. We outline future directions in evidence sufficiency, verifiable and correctable understanding, and budget-aware coordination, with an outlook on continual document understanding.
title: A Task-Centric Survey of Long-Document Visual Question Answering: Taxonomy, Evolution, and Future Directions
title_translated: 面向长文档视觉问答的任务中心型综述：分类体系、演进历程与未来方向
summary_translated: 视觉文档理解对于从视觉丰富的文档中获取知识至关重要，正吸引越来越多的研究关注。现有综述侧重于架构或技术方法，较少关注任务瓶颈如何塑造技术选择与研究重点。我们提出一种任务中心型综述，将长文档视觉问答（VQA）分解为四个组成部分：文档解析、证据组织与检索、生成器组织与学习、以及评估。针对每一部分，我们构建细粒度分类体系，并追溯其动机、技术响应及跨组件关联。我们重点关注显式检索，同时涵盖直接阅读。时间分析揭示了研究优先级的演变：从多模态内容理解扩展到充分且高保真的证据获取与持续的证据管理。我们展望未来方向，包括证据充分性、可验证与可修正的理解，以及预算感知的协调机制，并提出对持续文档理解的展望。

summary: Many LLM agents maintain external persistent memory and derive additional state from past interactions, such as summaries. Deleting an original memory record therefore need not remove information carried by its descendants. We introduce AfterDeleteBench, a controlled behavioral audit for this failure mode in fixed-weight LLM agents. For each synthetic secret, we compare an exposed-then-deleted agent with an otherwise matched agent that was never exposed to the secret, allowing post-deletion recovery to be attributed to the original exposure. In our primary setting, a single query recovers the deleted secret from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct in roughly two thirds of cases, while matched never-exposed controls have zero recovery. Crucially, recovery does not require a surviving verbatim copy: when the complete secret string is absent and only separately stored components remain under a public composition rule, exact reconstruction succeeds in 62-99% of cases across Qwen, Mistral, and Phi-3. We also show that the response interface is part of the measurement system: target-bearing replies can be scored as failures when the requested format and parser are misaligned. Finally, we separate reconstruction from write-back and fresh-session recall. Provenance-aware closure eliminates observed recovery in the tested positive-baseline settings, whereas an exact-literal write filter blocks reinsertion but cannot erase information already present. Together, these results show that source deletion should be evaluated behaviorally at the level of the agent and its memory system, not only as a storage operation.
title: AfterDeleteBench: Auditing Post-Deletion Information Persistence in LLM Agents
title_translated: AfterDeleteBench：评估大语言模型智能体在删除后的信息残留
summary_translated: 许多大语言模型智能体维持外部持久记忆，并从过往交互中衍生出额外状态（如摘要）。因此，删除原始记忆记录并不一定消除其后代所携带的信息。我们提出了AfterDeleteBench，一种针对固定权重大语言模型智能体中此类失效模式的受控行为审计方法。对于每个合成秘密，我们将一个曾暴露后被删除的智能体与一个从未接触该秘密的对照智能体进行比较，从而将删除后的信息恢复归因于原始暴露。在主要设置中，仅通过一次查询即可在约三分之二的情况下从Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct中恢复已删除的秘密，而对照组则完全无法恢复。关键的是，恢复并不需要保留完整的原文副本：当完整密文不存在，仅以公开组合规则分别存储的组件存在时，Qwen、Mistral和Phi-3在62%-99%的情况下仍能实现精确重建。我们还发现响应接口是测量系统的一部分：当请求格式与解析器不匹配时，含有目标的回答可被判定为失败。最后，我们区分了重建与重写回以及新会话召回。具备溯源意识的闭合机制在测试的正向基线设置中消除了观察到的恢复现象，而精确字面写入过滤器虽可阻止重新插入，但无法清除已存在的信息。这些结果表明，源删除应从智能体及其记忆系统的整体行为层面进行评估，而不仅视为存储操作。

summary: Memory enables language agents to carry useful distinctions from past experience into future decisions. Its value depends on which distinctions survive, whether a bounded agent can use them, and what can be recovered or revised as demands evolve. We develop a decision-theoretic framework that follows this value from raw history through persistent state, operational use, and costly recovery and revision. Original and retained value are expressed in units of avoided task loss; risk-cost frontiers describe attainable recovery and preservation across uses. Unknown demand yields value profiles, while interactive feedback changes the distribution of future work. A cost-aware simulation condition and five minimal counterexamples expose the roles of information timing, retrieval access, component interaction, feedback and demand uncertainty. In particular, a pointer with zero mutual information about the answer can still reduce the cost of exact recovery. Diagnostics on LoCoMo, a two-project update task and longitudinal cases exhibit failures of preservation, use and measurement. At fixed retrieved evidence, a saved ledger changes subsequent answers; at fixed agent outputs, an evaluator revision changes scores. The framework connects these distinctions to operational risk bounds and testable principles for allocating memory, preserving recovery options and revising evidence dependencies.
title: The Value of Memory in Language Agents
title_translated: 语言智能体中记忆的价值
summary_translated: 记忆使语言智能体能够将过去经验中的有用区分带入未来的决策中。其价值取决于哪些区分得以保留、有限智能体是否能使用它们，以及随着需求演变，哪些内容可以被恢复或修订。我们构建了一个决策论框架，追踪这一价值从原始历史经由持久状态、实际使用到代价高昂的恢复与修订全过程。原始价值与保留价值均以避免任务损失的单位表示；风险-成本边界描述了在不同用途下可达到的恢复与保存水平。未知需求产生价值分布，而交互反馈则改变未来工作的分布。通过成本感知的模拟条件及五个最小反例，揭示了信息时机、检索访问、组件交互、反馈和需求不确定性的作用。特别地，即使指针与答案之间互信息为零，仍可降低精确恢复的成本。对LoCoMo（双项目更新任务）和纵向案例的诊断暴露出保存、使用和测量方面的失败。在固定检索证据下，保存的账本会改变后续回答；在固定智能体输出下，评估者修订会改变评分。该框架将这些区分与操作风险边界联系起来，并提出可测试的原则，用于分配记忆、保留恢复选项和修订证据依赖关系。

summary: While arousal can be reliably predicted from musical audio, emotional valence remains difficult to model due to its subjective and context-dependent nature. In this work, we investigate the potential of in-context learning (ICL) with large language models to advance continuous valence and arousal prediction. Rather than predicting emotion scores directly, our framework leverages contextual demonstrations from an auxiliary dataset to refine the initial predictions produced by a small, task-specific base model. We systematically evaluate a text-based ICL variant using lyrics and generated audio captions, alongside a multimodal variant that incorporates raw audio signals. Using the entire MER60 dataset strictly as a held-out test set, our experiments demonstrate substantial performance gains, particularly for valence. Text-based ICL improves the valence $R^2$ from 0.110 to 0.427 with 80 demonstration shots, while the multimodal variant achieves 0.346 with only 10 shots. These findings suggest that training-free ICL offers an effective inference-time strategy for current language models to predict continuous music emotion.
title: Predicting Music Valence and Arousal via Textual and Multimodal In-Context Learning in Large Language Models
title_translated: 基于文本与多模态上下文学习的大语言模型预测音乐情绪唤醒度与效价
summary_translated: 虽然唤醒度可以从音乐音频中可靠预测，但情绪效价由于其主观性和情境依赖性，仍难以建模。本文研究了大语言模型中上下文学习（ICL）在推进连续效价与唤醒度预测方面的潜力。不同于直接预测情绪分数，我们的框架利用辅助数据集中的上下文示例来优化小型专用基础模型生成的初始预测。我们系统评估了基于文本的ICL变体（使用歌词和生成的音频描述）以及融合原始音频信号的多模态变体。严格将整个MER60数据集作为保留测试集，实验表明性能显著提升，尤其在效价预测方面。基于文本的ICL在80个示例提示下将效价的R²从0.110提升至0.427，而多模态变体仅用10个示例即达到0.346。这些发现表明，无需训练的ICL为当前语言模型提供了一种有效的推理时策略，用于预测连续音乐情绪。

summary: Deep research agents synthesize open-web evidence into long reports, but current benchmarks do not evaluate research centered on a source video. We introduce Video-Centered Deep Research Report Generation. Given a video and user request, an agent identifies research questions, retrieves external multimodal evidence, and produces an interactive report linked to relevant video moments. This task has direct practical value because it helps users locate relevant moments, verify claims, reproduce demonstrated procedures, and make informed decisions from video content. We present a skill-based workflow and OmniDR-Bench for this task. For evaluation, we propose Omni Atomic Rubric Trees (Omni-ARTs). Each tree contains three dimensions, 23 shared directions, and task-specific atomic binary criteria. The directions test audiovisual grounding, multimodal evidence use, and interactive presentation. Audited Rubric Construction (ARC) builds these trees through independent evidence collection, automated checks, behavioral calibration, and iterative human review. OmniDR-Bench contains 50 Chinese and English tasks across 19 realworld subcategories. It includes 6,414 criteria. Across 18 agent configurations, the best system scores 63.3 out of 100. Current agents still need broader content coverage, stronger causal and logical analysis across modalities, and more accurate citation support. We further analyze models, harnesses, skill configurations, video categories, and research trajectories. The code and data are released at https://github.com/marinero4972/OmniDR-Bench.
title: Beyond Watching and Searching: Benchmarking Agents for Video-centered Deep Research Reports
title_translated: 超越观看与搜索：面向视频中心深度研究报告的智能体基准评测
summary_translated: 深度研究智能体能够将开放网络证据整合成长篇报告，但现有基准未评估以源视频为中心的研究任务。我们引入视频中心深度研究报告生成任务。给定一段视频和用户请求，智能体需识别研究问题，检索外部多模态证据，并生成与相关视频片段联动的交互式报告。该任务具有直接实际价值，帮助用户定位相关内容、验证声明、复现演示步骤并基于视频内容做出明智决策。我们提出了基于技能的工作流和OmniDR-Bench基准。评估方面，我们提出Omni原子评分树（Omni-ARTs），每棵树包含三个维度、23个共享方向及任务特定的原子二元标准。方向涵盖视听对齐、多模态证据使用和交互式呈现。审计评分构建（ARC）通过独立证据收集、自动化检查、行为校准和迭代人工评审构建这些树。OmniDR-Bench包含50个中英文任务，覆盖19个真实世界子类别，共6,414个评估标准。在18种智能体配置中，最佳系统得分为63.3/100。当前智能体仍需更广泛的内容覆盖、更强的跨模态因果与逻辑分析能力，以及更准确的引用支持。我们进一步分析了模型、工具链、技能配置、视频类别和研究轨迹。代码与数据已发布于https://github.com/marinero4972/OmniDR-Bench。

summary: Procedural mistake recognition requires identifying deviations from valid multi-step activities. We study post-completion recognition from videos with benchmark-provided step boundaries. We introduce PRISM (Procedural mistake Recognition via Interpretable Semantic Modeling), which grounds video segments in language and maps their descriptions to procedural states using a lightweight hidden Markov model trained on correct executions. Reference alignment and semantic checks identify errors in step content and order. To support evaluation across heterogeneous benchmarks, we map dataset-specific annotations to four edit-based error types: insertion, deletion, substitution, and transposition. Across three benchmarks, we compare gold and VLM-generated descriptions in raw, semantic-role, and action-object forms. Decoder controls show consistent gains from the trained local decoder over nearest-candidate matching, with additional, dataset-dependent benefits from sequence decoding. Semantic role labeling improves Any-F1 in all six matched grounded comparisons, although the gains vary across datasets and do not translate into uniform improvements under separate configuration selection. These results establish language grounding as an effective interface for explicit procedural mistake reasoning and characterize the contributions of representation and decoding.
title: Through a PRISM, Clearly: Step-Sequence Reasoning for Mistake Recognition in Procedural Videos
title_translated: 透过PRISM，清晰识别：程序视频中的错误识别步骤序列推理
summary_translated: 程序错误识别需要识别偏离有效多步活动的偏差。我们研究了在基准提供的步骤边界基础上，完成后的错误识别。我们提出了PRISM（基于可解释语义建模的程序错误识别），将视频片段与语言对齐，并使用在正确执行上训练的轻量级隐马尔可夫模型，将描述映射到程序状态。参考对齐与语义检查识别步骤内容与顺序中的错误。为支持跨异构基准的评估，我们将数据集特定标注映射为四种基于编辑的错误类型：插入、删除、替换和置换。在三个基准上，我们比较了黄金标注与视觉语言模型生成的描述在原始、语义角色和动作-对象形式下的表现。解码控制显示，经过训练的局部解码器相比最近候选匹配具有一致优势，且在某些数据集上序列解码带来额外收益。语义角色标注在所有六组配对的有根基比较中提升了Any-F1，尽管增益在不同数据集间差异明显，且在单独配置选择下并未转化为统一提升。这些结果确立了语言对齐作为显式程序错误推理的有效接口，并刻画了表示与解码的贡献。

summary: Policy enforcement for LLM agents has shifted from single-turn content moderation to compound, application-specific policies evaluated over multi-turn transcripts and tool-call trajectories. Fine-tuned guardrail models are efficient but degrade on compound policies, and while LLM-as-a-judge approaches achieve higher accuracy, they incur high inference cost and tend to produce unstable predictions. Neurosymbolic methods offer a natural alternative, decomposing the policy into narrow neural decisions composed under explicit logic. However, existing symbolic layers lack the required expressiveness and are optimized against fixed data rather than the policy itself. To address this, we introduce SCOPE, which compiles a policy into an executable program of neural predicates executed by small models, deterministic extractors, and code that composes their outputs. The program is optimized jointly with its training data, using adversarial generation of counterexamples that target where the program deviates from the policy. We evaluate SCOPE on a benchmark of real-world policy tasks against prompt optimization, task decomposition, and workflow generation methods, achieving the highest average accuracy across tasks and models. Programs optimized with the weakest executor transfer to other models without further optimization. This allows them to be deployed in production on inexpensive models, where they reach accuracy comparable to frontier reasoning models. Unlike these monolithic models, SCOPE produces substantially more stable predictions, and each verdict is interpretable through the predicate outputs that produced it. Additionally, we validate the key components of our method through an ablation study. SCOPE thus enables reliable, interpretable, and efficient policy enforcement at production scale.
title: SCOPE: Compiling Natural-Language Policies into Neurosymbolic Predicate Programs
title_translated: SCOPE：将自然语言策略编译为神经符号谓词程序
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体的策略执行已从单轮内容审核转向基于多轮对话和工具调用轨迹评估的复合、应用特定策略。微调的护栏模型虽高效，但在复合策略上性能下降；而使用LLM作为裁判的方法虽然准确率更高，但推理成本高且预测不稳定。神经符号方法提供了一种自然替代方案，将策略分解为在显式逻辑下组合的窄范围神经决策。然而，现有符号层缺乏必要的表达能力，且针对固定数据而非策略本身进行优化。为此，我们提出SCOPE，它将策略编译为由小型模型、确定性提取器和代码组成的可执行神经谓词程序，这些代码组合其输出。该程序与其训练数据联合优化，利用对抗性生成反例来针对性地修正程序与策略之间的偏差。我们在真实世界策略任务基准上对SCOPE进行了评估，相比提示优化、任务分解和工作流生成方法，实现了各项任务和模型上的最高平均准确率。使用最弱执行器优化的程序无需进一步优化即可迁移到其他模型，从而可在低成本模型上部署，达到与前沿推理模型相当的准确率。与这些整体模型不同，SCOPE产生的预测更加稳定，每个判断结果均可通过生成它的谓词输出进行解释。此外，我们通过消融研究验证了方法的关键组件。因此，SCOPE实现了生产规模下可靠、可解释且高效的策略执行。

summary: Personal agents need to draw on long-term interaction history to retrieve and apply external knowledge suited to a user's current request. Even an answer grounded in relevant documents can be unsuitable when it overlooks the user's circumstances. This creates two connected challenges: using historical conditions to identify the knowledge needed for a new request, and applying that knowledge to the user's situation. Existing benchmarks advance memory recall, personalized retrieval, and memory-guided action, while the joint evaluation of these two challenges remains underexplored. We introduce ColaBench, a synthetic benchmark in health and daily living, with 349 tasks across 10 Profiles and a knowledge base of 13,033 documents. Its Evidence Graph connects personal conditions to their disclosures across public interaction sessions, records prior document exposure, and links answer requirements to personal and newly acquired document evidence. We also introduce MemKB, which uses state summaries to inform queries and rule application, and memory-document links to retrieve knowledge associated with the user's history. MemKB achieves 86.25% Accuracy with an average of 4.07 interaction rounds per task. Task-level analysis finds larger gains on tasks integrating information across multiple historical Facts; error analysis further identifies unsupported personal assumptions and rule misapplication as obstacles to using retrieved evidence. ColaBench provides traceable tasks and an evaluation framework for studying how memory guides knowledge acquisition and rule application.
title: ColaBench: Evaluating Memory-Guided Knowledge Acquisition in Personal Agents
title_translated: ColaBench：评估个人智能体中的记忆引导知识获取
summary_translated: 个人智能体需要利用长期交互历史来检索并应用适合用户当前请求的外部知识。即使答案基于相关文档，若忽略用户情境也可能不适用。这带来了两个相互关联的挑战：利用历史条件识别新请求所需的知识，并将该知识应用于用户情境。现有基准推进了记忆召回、个性化检索和记忆引导行动，但对这两个挑战的联合评估仍处于探索阶段。我们引入ColaBench，一个健康与日常生活领域的合成基准，包含10个用户档案下的349项任务和13,033份文档的知识库。其证据图将个人状况与其在公开交互会话中的披露相连接，记录先前的文档暴露情况，并将答案需求与个人及新获取的文档证据关联。我们还引入MemKB，利用状态摘要指导查询与规则应用，并通过记忆-文档链接检索与用户历史相关的知识。MemKB在每项任务平均4.07轮交互中达到86.25%的准确率。任务层面分析发现，在整合多个历史事实的任务上提升更显著；错误分析进一步指出，未经支持的个人假设和规则误用是使用检索证据的主要障碍。ColaBench提供了可追溯的任务和评估框架，用于研究记忆如何引导知识获取与规则应用。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate UML class diagrams from natural language requirements, but hallucinations may compromise the correctness and completeness of the resulting diagrams. Existing evaluations mostly assess the final diagram, without examining the intermediate traces of reasoning-capable LLMs, which can reveal where these hallucinations arise. We develop an empirical taxonomy of eleven hallucination sub-types organised into three dimensions: Prompt Faithfulness (deviations between requirements and reasoning), Code Faithfulness (discrepancies between reasoning and generated PlantUML code), and Reasoning Quality (problems within the reasoning). The taxonomy was derived from 60 manually annotated DeepSeek-R1 traces, applied to 120 further DeepSeek-R1 traces through a dual-LLM annotation pipeline, and examined on 20 DeepSeek-V4-Pro traces. Code Faithfulness was the most frequent dimension for DeepSeek-R1 in both datasets, whereas Prompt Faithfulness dominated for DeepSeek-V4-Pro, suggesting model-dependent failure patterns. In the manually annotated traces, reasoning-trace length showed no significant monotonic association with hallucination frequency, whereas requirement complexity was negatively associated with it, particularly for Prompt Faithfulness errors. In a mitigation experiment on 13 Golden UML ModelSet cases with three Qwen3-based models, adding Prompt Faithfulness and Reasoning Quality constraints to the generation prompt raised the pooled mean F1 score by 4.0 percentage points, whereas a post-hoc Code Faithfulness review provided no consistent further benefit. Relationship modelling remained the lowest-scoring element throughout. These results suggest that localising hallucinations within the generation process can inform targeted, prompt-based mitigation. Whether these findings generalise beyond the DeepSeek and Qwen3 model families remains to be tested.
title: Tracing Hallucinations in LLM Reasoning for UML Class Diagram Generation: An Empirical Taxonomy and Mitigation Study
title_translated: 追踪LLM推理中UML类图生成的幻觉：一项实证分类与缓解研究
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）可以从自然语言需求生成UML类图，但幻觉可能损害生成图的正确性和完整性。现有评估大多仅关注最终图，未考察具备推理能力的LLM的中间推理轨迹，而这些轨迹可揭示幻觉的来源。我们构建了一个包含十一类子类型的实证幻觉分类体系，分为三个维度：提示忠实度（需求与推理之间的偏差）、代码忠实度（推理与生成的PlantUML代码之间的差异）以及推理质量（推理过程中的问题）。该分类体系基于60条人工标注的DeepSeek-R1推理轨迹，通过双LLM标注流程应用于另外120条DeepSeek-R1轨迹，并在20条DeepSeek-V4-Pro轨迹上进行检验。在两个数据集中，DeepSeek-R1的代码忠实度维度最为频繁，而DeepSeek-V4-Pro则以提示忠实度为主，表明模型依赖性的失败模式。在人工标注轨迹中，推理轨迹长度与幻觉频率无显著单调关系，而需求复杂度与幻觉频率呈负相关，尤其在提示忠实度错误中表现明显。在13个黄金UML模型集案例上，使用三个Qwen3基模型进行缓解实验，向生成提示中加入提示忠实度和推理质量约束，使合并平均F1得分提高4.0个百分点；而事后代码忠实度审查未带来一致收益。关系建模始终是得分最低的环节。这些结果表明，定位生成过程中幻觉的位置可为基于提示的针对性缓解提供依据。这些发现是否适用于DeepSeek和Qwen3以外的模型家族仍有待验证。

summary: Fine-grained image-text retrieval requires a model not only to assess global semantic consistency between an image and a text, but also to model visual evidence for local textual semantics, including objects, attributes, quantities, actions, and relations, so as to distinguish semantically similar candidates. Existing methods commonly use fixed image patches, detected regions, or text tokens as the basic matching units and then aggregate local interactions through max pooling, cross attention, or similarity accumulation. Such strategies remain limited in semantic unit construction and global matching consistency. This paper proposes a hierarchical fine-grained cross-modal alignment framework, termed HFCMA. The framework progressively transforms low-level patch and token representations into adaptive visual regions and textual phrases, and then performs structured region-phrase matching within a global retrieval scoring process. Specifically, HFCMA first adopts dynamic granularity discovery (DGD) to aggregate raw patches and tokens into semantically compact visual regions and textual phrases. It then formulates region-phrase matching as an entropy-regularized optimal transport problem, thereby estimating a structured alignment matrix under global marginal constraints. To reduce background noise and local semantic drift, HFCMA further introduces background debiasing, textual importance weighting, and prototype consistency regularization. Experiments on Flickr30K and MS-COCO show that HFCMA effectively combines dynamic semantic unit construction with OT-based structured matching under a dual-encoder retrieval framework. The resulting fine-grained score provides structured local alignment information for candidate ranking and improves the discrimination of subtle semantic differences.
title: Hierarchical Fine-Grained Cross-Modal Alignment via Dynamic Granularity Discovery and Optimal Transport
comment: 8 figures, 6 tables. Code available at this https URL
title_translated: 基于动态粒度发现与最优传输的分层细粒度跨模态对齐
summary_translated: 细粒度图像-文本检索要求模型不仅评估图像与文本之间的全局语义一致性，还需建模视觉证据以支持局部文本语义，包括物体、属性、数量、动作和关系，从而区分语义相似的候选项。现有方法通常使用固定的图像块、检测区域或文本标记作为基本匹配单元，再通过最大池化、交叉注意力或相似性累积聚合局部交互。此类策略在语义单元构建和全局匹配一致性方面仍受限。本文提出一种分层细粒度跨模态对齐框架，称为HFCMA。该框架逐步将低层次的块和标记表示转化为自适应的视觉区域和文本短语，并在全局检索评分过程中执行结构化的区域-短语匹配。具体而言，HFCMA首先采用动态粒度发现（DGD）将原始块和标记聚合为语义紧凑的视觉区域和文本短语。随后，将区域-短语匹配形式化为熵正则化的最优传输问题，从而在全局边缘约束下估计结构化对齐矩阵。为减少背景噪声和局部语义漂移，HFCMA进一步引入背景去偏、文本重要性加权和原型一致性正则化。在Flickr30K和MS-COCO上的实验表明，HFCMA在双编码器检索框架下有效结合了动态语义单元构建与基于OT的结构化匹配。所得细粒度得分提供了候选排序的结构化局部对齐信息，提升了细微语义差异的判别能力。

summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is credited with teaching reasoning models to write {wait} before reconsidering a step, yet large RL accuracy gains do not require the word. This view can confuse what RL discovers with what a model inherits from its training data. We trace the word through open models' training histories, reading it with label-free indices of frequency, position, form and usage and an injected-error test, all computed from sampled outputs. We find that zero-RL almost never coins the marker: on bases that lack the word, RL raises MATH-500 accuracy substantially while {wait} stays near absent. It arrives with training data: mid-training in OLMo-3, and fine-tuning on reasoning traces installs it in most models whose base lacks it. Where the base already uses it, both released RL-Zero recipes (OLMo-3, MiMo) multiply it, whereas KL-free GRPO from the same base does not; OLMo-3's recipe wears down its form and makes it a more sensitive but more liberal alarm; RL after supervised fine-tuning barely changes it, and our GRPO recipe erases a marker seeded by fine-tuning. Finally, we show that marker frequency alone does not indicate RL-induced reasoning and caution against LLM-as-a-judge revision metrics, as automated judges can reverse human-labelled trends.
title: Inherited, Not Invented: Tracing the Provenance of Wait in Reasoning Models
title_translated: 传承而非创造：追踪推理模型中“等待”标记的来源
summary_translated: 强化学习（RL）被认为教会了推理模型在重新考虑步骤前写下“wait”，但大规模RL精度提升并不依赖于该词汇。这一观点可能混淆了RL所发现的内容与模型从训练数据中继承的内容。我们通过开放模型的训练历史追踪该词，利用频率、位置、形式和使用方式的无标签索引，以及从采样输出中计算的注入错误测试。我们发现，零RL几乎从不创造该标记：在缺乏该词的基础模型上，RL显著提升MATH-500准确率，而“wait”仍几乎不存在。该词随训练数据出现：在OLMo-3的中期训练中出现，而在推理轨迹上的微调将其安装到大多数基础模型中。若基础模型已使用该词，则发布的RL-Zero方案（OLMo-3、MiMo）均使其数量增加，而同源的无KL的GRPO方案则不会；OLMo-3的方案削弱了其形式，使其成为更敏感但更宽松的警报；在监督微调后的RL几乎不改变它，而我们的GRPO方案则抹除了微调引入的标记。最后，我们指出标记频率本身并不能说明RL引发的推理，并警告不要使用LLM作为裁判的修订指标，因为自动裁判可能逆转人类标注的趋势。

summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by training a model on its own trajectories with dense token-level supervision from a privileged copy conditioned on a reference solution. Existing methods typically use a single teacher distribution conditioned on the complete reference. We identify a limitation of this formulation: a reference is only one realization of the reasoning process. Although it provides evidence about the answer, it also encodes an ordering, phrasing, and solution path. Full-reference conditioning can therefore produce correct targets that depend excessively on information unavailable to the student at inference. We show that replacing one valid reference with another, while holding the problem and student state fixed, can substantially alter the teacher distribution, a phenomenon we call reference-induced target instability. To address this instability, we introduce Monte Carlo Privileged Distillation (MCPD), which models privileged context as a distribution over partial reference views and distills the marginal teacher distribution. MCPD evaluates the teacher under multiple views and averages the resulting next-token distributions. We show that this probability-space average is the exact target induced by minimizing the expected teacher-to-student KL divergence over privileged views. Across mathematical and scientific reasoning benchmarks, we show that MCPD produces more reference-consistent supervision and consistently improves over full-reference OPSD.
title: One Teacher, Many Views: Reducing Reference Sensitivity in On-Policy Self-Distillation
title_translated: 一个教师，多种视角：降低策略内自蒸馏中的参考依赖性
summary_translated: 策略内自蒸馏（OPSD）通过使用特权副本在完整参考解的基础上提供密集的词级别监督来提升模型的推理能力。现有方法通常仅使用单一受完整参考条件约束的教师分布。我们发现该范式的局限性：参考解只是推理过程的一个实现版本。尽管它提供了答案的证据，但也编码了顺序、措辞和解题路径。完全依赖参考条件可能导致正确目标过度依赖学生在推理时无法获取的信息。我们发现，在保持问题和学生状态不变的情况下，将一个有效参考替换为另一个，会显著改变教师分布，这种现象称为参考引起的目标不稳定性。为解决此问题，我们提出蒙特卡洛特权蒸馏（MCPD），将特权上下文建模为部分参考视图的分布，并蒸馏边际教师分布。MCPD在多个视图下评估教师并平均得到的下一个词分布。我们证明，这种概率空间的平均正是最小化特权视图上教师到学生KL散度期望所诱导的精确目标。在数学和科学推理基准测试中，MCPD生成了更一致于参考的监督信号，并持续优于全参考OPSD。

summary: Mixing requires not only applying processing but also assessing the resulting mix. Audio-language models can provide conversa- tional mixing advice, but existing evaluations do not separately test whether they can judge specific mixing issues. Since professional supervision for such judgments is scarce, we construct a curriculum of 11 vocal-mix issues at multiple severity levels and use it to train MixJudge, a language-queryable audio critic. MixJudge shows its ability to retrieve mixing issues, distinguish opposite issues, and order the severity of an issue. Moreover, its judgments transfer to menu selection: given a set of processing candidates, MixJudge often favors versions acoustically closer to a held-out professional version, demonstrating how explicit mixing judgment can support comparison and downstream mixing decisions.
title: MixJudge: Learning a Language-Queryable Critic for Vocal Mixing
title_translated: MixJudge：学习一种可语言查询的混音评判器
summary_translated: 混音不仅需要应用处理，还需要评估最终混音效果。音频-语言模型可以提供对话式混音建议，但现有评估方法未单独测试它们是否能判断具体的混音问题。由于专业人员对这类判断的监督数据稀缺，我们构建了一个包含11种人声混音问题及其多级严重程度的课程，并用于训练MixJudge——一种可语言查询的音频评判器。MixJudge展示了其检索混音问题、区分相反问题以及排序问题严重程度的能力。此外，其判断可迁移至菜单选择：给定一组处理候选方案，MixJudge通常偏好在声学上更接近保留的专业版本的选项，表明明确的混音判断如何支持比较与下游混音决策。

summary: AI assistants built on large language models (LLMs) are trained on human feedback and increasingly personalized to users' stated preferences. Yet how closely these preferences reflect what people reward in responses remains unclear. We compare stated and revealed preferences in the public PRISM dataset, in which 1,396 participants reported how much seven response attributes mattered to them and then rated 29,347 responses from 21 LLMs. Among responses to the same prompt, features the survey never asked about, such as response length, formatting and refusal language, were at least as strongly associated with ratings as text proxies of the surveyed attributes. Whether stated priorities matched ratings depended on how attributes were measured: participants who prioritized an attribute favoured responses from models that others perceived as strong on it, but not responses that scored higher on text proxies for it. Written feedback was more telling: participants who asked for shorter answers, even in earlier conversations, gave length less weight in their ratings, and those asking for longer answers gave it more. Their relative priorities over the surveyed attributes, however, did not predict this weight. Reasons given for choices reflected perceived attributes more than measured features. Participants also differed stably in how much they weighted several concrete features, especially length, but with a median of 6 conversations per participant, these weights were estimated poorly. The largest gain from personal information in predicting held-out choices was 0.13 percentage points, compared with 1.11 for a stronger pooled model. Stated priorities thus track perceived attributes of AI responses but say little about the concrete features that ratings reward, a distinction that matters for preference elicitation and AI personalization.
title: Abstract Priorities, Concrete Rewards: How Stated Preferences Relate to What People Reward in AI Responses

title_translated: 抽象优先级，具体奖励：人们陈述的偏好如何反映其对AI响应的实际奖励
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型（LLMs）构建的AI助手通过人类反馈进行训练，并日益个性化以适应用户的陈述偏好。然而，这些偏好与人们实际奖励的响应特征之间的对应关系仍不清晰。我们在公开的PRISM数据集中对比了陈述偏好与揭示偏好，其中1,396名参与者报告了七个响应属性对他们的重要性，随后对21个LLM生成的29,347条响应进行了评分。在相同提示下的响应中，调查未涉及的特征（如响应长度、格式和拒绝用语）与评分的相关性至少与调查属性的文字代理指标相当。陈述优先级是否匹配评分取决于属性的测量方式：那些重视某一属性的参与者更倾向于选择他人认为在该属性上表现强的模型，而非在文字代理指标上得分更高的模型。书面反馈更具启示性：即使在早期对话中要求更短的回答，参与者在评分时也会降低对长度的权重；反之，要求更长回答者则赋予长度更高权重。然而，他们对调查属性的相对优先级并不能预测这一权重变化。选择理由更多反映了感知属性而非测量特征。参与者在对若干具体特征（尤其是长度）的权重上表现出稳定差异，但由于每位参与者平均仅参与6次对话，这些权重估计不准确。利用个人信息预测保留选择的最大增益仅为0.13个百分点，而更强的聚合模型可达到1.11个百分点。因此，陈述偏好追踪的是AI响应的感知属性，却很少反映评分所奖励的具体特征，这一区别对偏好获取与AI个性化至关重要。

summary: Can a small change in wording move an AI model from refusing a sensitive request to acting on it? We test 15 models on the same request to increase the income shown on a pay stub. Across 445 observable trials, models issue editing calls in 14.1% of cases when a loan purpose is stated, 33.1% when the purpose is omitted, and 66.2% when the change is described as fixing a printing error. Astra refuses all ten loan-purpose requests but issues calls in all ten purpose-omitted trials. Fable, Opus, and Muse Spark issue none across all three wordings; Sonnet issues some under the latter two. Response excerpts illustrate different ways of refusing, redirecting, or justifying an edit. The file is a marked test document and all tools are simulated. These results probe how boundaries behave in one setting; they do not prove an overall ethics ranking or that a harmful real-world edit succeeded.
title: How Firm Are AI Models' Ethical Boundaries? A Pay-Stub Editing Test of 15 Models

title_translated: AI模型的伦理边界有多坚定？15个模型的工资单编辑测试
summary_translated: 微小的措辞变化是否能让AI模型从拒绝敏感请求转变为执行？我们在同一请求下测试了15个模型，要求增加工资单上的收入金额。在445次可观测试验中，当说明贷款用途时，模型发出编辑调用的比例为14.1%；当用途被省略时上升至33.1%；当更改描述为修复打印错误时则高达66.2%。Astra在所有十次贷款用途请求中均拒绝，但在所有十次用途省略的试验中都发出了调用。Fable、Opus和Muse Spark在三种表述下均未发出任何调用；Sonnet在后两种表述下发出了一些调用。响应摘录展示了不同的拒绝、引导或合理化方式。文件为标记测试文档，所有工具均为模拟。这些结果探究了边界在特定情境下的行为表现；但并不证明整体伦理排名，也不意味着有害的真实世界编辑已成功。

summary: When a multilingual LLM agrees with a user's false premise, is it being sycophantic, or does it simply not know better in that language? Current research does not distinguish these cases: they record only whether the model agreed, not why. We introduce the SC-matrix, that crosses a model's competence (whether it answers correctly under no pressure) with its sycophancy (whether it maintains that answer under pressure). Our results show that (1) identical aggregate sycophancy rates can mask different failure compositions, (2) high competence in a language does not always protect against sycophancy, and (3) reasoning-oriented mitigations outperform directive-based strategies. We find that multilingual sycophancy is not a single phenomenon but a composite of different failures that require distinct diagnosis.
title: Disentangling Robustness and Sycophancy in Multilingual LLMs
title_translated: 解耦多语言大模型的鲁棒性与奉承性
summary_translated: 当多语言大模型同意用户错误的前提时，是出于奉承，还是仅仅因为在该语言中不知更好？当前研究未能区分这两种情况：仅记录模型是否同意，而不分析原因。我们引入SC矩阵，将模型的能力（在无压力下正确回答的能力）与奉承性（在压力下维持该回答的倾向）进行交叉分析。我们的结果表明：(1) 相同的总体奉承率可能掩盖不同的失败构成；(2) 在某种语言中高能力并不总能防止奉承；(3) 基于推理的缓解策略优于基于指令的策略。我们发现，多语言奉承并非单一现象，而是由多种不同失败组成的复合体，需采用不同诊断方法。

summary: Safety probes trained on a model's activations are a standard tool for monitoring language models in real time. Each time a new model is released or a new harm area needs to be monitored, the probe must be retrained, which requires new labels and a choice of probe architecture. Yet neither the model nor the labels tell us in advance how well the resulting probe will perform. Finding out requires training and comparing many probe configurations. In this paper, we ask whether probe performance can instead be predicted in advance from model size and the number of labels. Existing safety datasets are insufficient for this, as they are either limited in scale or already saturated. We therefore construct six new safety datasets of sufficient size and difficulty. On these datasets, we train two probe architectures on 20 base models from five model families, with 32 to $10^{6}$ labels for each model. We measure performance using probe error, defined as 1 - AUROC, where lower values are better. We find that probe error follows two simple scaling laws. First, the lowest probe error a model can reach falls as a power law in its size. Second, probe error decreases towards its floor as the number of examples increases; the slope increases as the target model size increases. Both laws hold across tasks, model families and probe architectures, and only their fitted constants differ. When fitted on the smallest models of a family, the laws predict the error of the next larger model to within 0.02 in 72% of cases. They also identify whether more labels or a larger model is the cheaper way to reach a target error in 73% of cases. Finally, they choose the probe architecture with an extra error of only 0.006 on average when they pick the worse one. These laws allow safety researchers to determine how to create the best probe for any given model and label budget.
title: Scaling Laws for Safety Probes
title_translated: 安全探测器的缩放定律
summary_translated: 在模型激活值上训练的安全探测器是实时监控语言模型的标准工具。每次发布新模型或需要监控新的有害领域时，都必须重新训练探测器，这需要新的标注数据和探测器架构的选择。然而，无论是模型本身还是标注数据都无法提前告诉我们探测器的性能如何。要了解性能，需要训练并比较多种探测器配置。本文探讨是否可以通过模型规模和标注数量来预先预测探测器性能。现有的安全数据集不足以支持这一目标，因为它们要么规模有限，要么已经饱和。因此，我们构建了六个足够大且具有挑战性的新安全数据集。在这些数据集上，我们在五个模型家族的20个基础模型上训练了两种探测器架构，每个模型使用32到$10^6$条标注数据。我们使用探测器误差（定义为1 - AUROC，数值越低越好）来衡量性能。我们发现探测器误差遵循两个简单的缩放定律：第一，模型所能达到的最低探测器误差随模型规模呈幂律下降；第二，随着样本数量增加，探测器误差趋近于其下限，且斜率随目标模型规模增大而增加。这两个定律在不同任务、模型家族和探测器架构中均成立，仅拟合常数有所不同。当在某一家族最小模型上进行拟合时，该定律在72%的情况下能将下一更大模型的误差预测在0.02以内。它们还能在73%的情况下识别出达到目标误差时，增加标注数据还是扩大模型更经济。最后，当选择较差的探测器架构时，平均仅带来0.006的额外误差。这些定律使安全研究人员能够根据给定的模型和标注预算，确定创建最佳探测器的方法。

summary: Autoregressive encoder-decoder speech recognition models trained with teacher forcing can suffer from exposure bias, limiting their ability to recover from their own prediction errors at inference time. Recent work has shown that reinforcement learning with Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) improves speech recognition in major languages with LLM-based models. We extend this line of work to smaller, non-LLM encoder-decoder ASR models, using Whisper-large-v3 as a case study across 51 African languages. The benefits of this approach are most pronounced when training data is scarce or when input audio is noisy or degraded. Our resulting model, SunflowerASR, achieves the best published macro-averaged WER on the AfriVox-v2 (0.227) and SimbaBench (0.372) benchmarks, and is publicly available.
title: Group Relative Policy Optimisation Improves Multilingual Speech Recognition in Low-Resource Languages
title_translated: 组相对策略优化提升低资源语言的多语言语音识别
summary_translated: 使用教师强制训练的自回归编码器-解码器语音识别模型可能受到暴露偏差的影响，限制其在推理时从自身预测错误中恢复的能力。最近的研究表明，采用组相对策略优化（GRPO）的强化学习方法可改善基于大语言模型的主流语言语音识别效果。我们将这一研究方向扩展到较小的非LLM编码器-解码器自动语音识别模型，以Whisper-large-v3为例，在51种非洲语言上进行实验。该方法在训练数据稀缺或输入音频嘈杂或退化时优势尤为明显。我们提出的模型SunflowerASR在AfriVox-v2（0.227）和SimbaBench（0.372）基准上取得了当前最优的宏平均词错误率（WER），并且已公开可用。

summary: Hybrid retrieval, which fuses a sparse lexical retriever with a dense neural one, is widely recommended in the software documentation surveyed in September 2026, usually with reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), on the strength of aggregate gains. We ask what fusion costs on individual queries, treating "do not fuse" as a first-class outcome, in the setting in which hybrid retrieval is deployed: a standard Anserini BM25, five dense encoders spanning 22M-596M parameters and three model generations, a learned-sparse (SPLADE) alternative, and a cross-encoder second stage, on seven BEIR datasets and three fusion functions. Even the best method, dense-weighted score interpolation, ranks relevant documents below the better of its two components on 13-48% of queries and below the deployable dense-only retriever on 8-21% (14-48% and 11-25% at a weight selected under leave-one-corpus-out validation), while beating dense-only in aggregate on every corpus with the primary encoder; the downside is significant under loss-averse risk-sensitive evaluation on six of the seven corpora. We call this loss the fusion tax. It is mostly a ranking effect that preserves recall in aggregate, it is most likely on the queries that only one retriever covers, and it persists across the encoder ladder and the SPLADE substitution. RRF carries the higher tax wherever the dense retriever is clearly stronger and only beats dense-only where the two components are balanced. Fusion failure is weakly predictable within a corpus but transfers unreliably across corpora, because the features that predict it change sign with the sparse-dense balance. A cross-encoder recovers part of the tax only where it is itself reliable. We distill these findings into guidance that keys the fusion decision to the measured sparse-dense balance of the target corpus.
title: The Fusion Tax: A Diagnostic Analysis of When Hybrid Retrieval Hurts
title_translated: 融合税：对混合检索何时造成损害的诊断分析
summary_translated: 混合检索（将稀疏词汇检索器与密集神经检索器融合）在2026年9月调查的软件文档中被广泛推荐，通常采用倒数排名融合（RRF），基于整体性能提升。我们在此部署场景下探究融合在单个查询上的代价，将“不融合”视为一个首要选项：标准Anserini BM25、五种密集编码器（参数量22M至596M）、三种模型版本、一种学习型稀疏（SPLADE）替代方案以及交叉编码器第二阶段，覆盖七个BEIR数据集和三种融合函数。即使表现最好的方法——密集加权得分插值，在13%-48%的查询中将相关文档排在两个组件中的更好者之下，且在8%-21%的查询中低于可部署的纯密集检索器（在留一语料库验证选择权重时分别为14%-48%和11%-25%），尽管在所有语料库中整体优于纯密集检索。在六组语料库中，这种劣势在损失厌恶、风险敏感评估下尤为显著。我们称此损失为“融合税”。它主要是一种排序效应，整体召回率得以保持；最可能出现在仅由单一检索器覆盖的查询上，并在编码器层级和SPLADE替换中持续存在。RRF在密集检索器明显更强时承担更高税负，仅在两组件平衡时才优于纯密集检索。融合失败在语料库内部弱可预测，但跨语料库不可靠，因为预测其失败的特征会随稀疏-密集平衡变化符号。交叉编码器仅在其自身可靠时才能部分恢复该税负。我们据此提炼出指导原则，建议融合决策应基于目标语料库中稀疏-密集平衡的实际测量结果。

summary: Natural language querying for time series databases aims to let users find what they need in long histories of data by asking in plain language. Shape queries ask how a series moves. They are the main challenge of this task. Recent work makes them feasible by using symbolization as a bridge between the query and the long history. However, existing symbolizations were designed for compression, similarity indexing, or classification. What a symbolization should provide for natural language querying has not been systematically studied. We therefore examine the definitions of six classical symbolizations against this task and identify three limitations. (1) Direction is missing from the string, (2) direction is measured at too small a scale, and (3) the letters are arbitrary. Three design principles follow. We follow these principles and make a minimal redesign of SAX called TT-SAX (two-track SAX). The level letters stay. Each segment gains a trend letter. It is measured across neighboring segments rather than inside one, and graded to match the adjectives that queries use. We conduct extensive experiments on the public NLQTSBench benchmark, comparing TT-SAX with the six classical symbolizations across six LLMs. TT-SAX outperforms all six on shape queries, and ablations trace its gains back to the three limitations one by one. This paper is the first systematic study of time series symbolization with natural language querying as the design goal. It provides a foundation for future research on this task. Our code is available at https://github.com/Atlamtiz/tt-sax.
title: TT-SAX: A Two-Track Time Series Symbolization for Natural Language Shape Querying

title_translated: TT-SAX：用于自然语言形状查询的时间序列符号化双轨方法
summary_translated: 面向时间序列数据库的自然语言查询旨在让用户通过自然语言提问，从长期数据历史中找到所需内容。形状查询关注的是序列如何变化，是该任务的主要挑战。近期工作通过符号化作为查询与长历史之间的桥梁，使形状查询成为可能。然而，现有符号化方法是为压缩、相似性索引或分类设计的，尚未系统研究其在自然语言查询中的应有特性。因此，我们针对该任务考察六种经典符号化方法的定义，并识别出三个局限性：(1) 字符串中缺失方向信息，(2) 方向测量尺度过小，(3) 字母选择任意。由此提出三项设计原则。我们遵循这些原则，对SAX进行了最小重构，提出TT-SAX（双轨SAX）。保留原有级别字母，每个段落新增趋势字母，其测量范围跨越相邻段落而非单个段落，并按查询中使用的形容词分级。我们在公开的NLQTSBench基准上进行了大量实验，比较TT-SAX与六种经典符号化方法在六种LLM上的表现。TT-SAX在形状查询上全面优于其他六种方法，消融实验也逐一验证了其改进源于对上述三个局限性的克服。本文是首次以自然语言查询为目标的设计导向的时间序列符号化系统性研究，为未来该领域的研究奠定了基础。代码已开源：https://github.com/Atlamtiz/tt-sax。

summary: LLM agents that act on live Web data must combine heterogeneous evidence, remember what they have done and improve from outcomes without weakening their own safeguards. We study this problem in autonomous investing, where every action is irreversible and based on untrusted Web content. We present Steward, a multi-agent LLM system that draws the boundary of self-evolution in its type system. First, nine role-specialised agents decide jointly: four analysts read news feeds, SEC filings, macroeconomic series and market data and emit typed reports, from which a Portfolio Manager sets target positions that a protected Risk Manager audits. Second, a seven-layer shared memory, assembled by code from the system's own record, gives each decision its position context, the market narrative, calibration and the agent's past decisions. Third, the system improves itself by review: code grades every trade and forecast nightly and writes the grades into memory, and each quarter a reflector proposes prompt learnings that a deterministic gate applies reversibly and replay of recorded inputs verifies. All three operate around an invariant core of order arithmetic, risk rules and discipline-agent prompts that no self-edit can reach. In a five-month live deployment (102 trading days, 1,632 LLM calls), the system contained a 24.6% sector drawdown to a 0.3% loss; in replay of its recorded inputs, a single model given the same raw data traded more and lost 1.35 points against the market over five days where the joint design showed no significant loss, and no injected instruction was followed; and a 2015-2026 backtest shows the core alone lowering the maximum drawdown under all 50 random entry policies. The reflector traced the dominant failure to its root cause, and the gate applied a learning that the agent adopted on trigger evenings and on no control evening. Code: https://github.com/yebof/quant-agent
title: Governed Self-Evolution for Autonomous Investing: A Multi-Agent LLM System with an Invariant Core
title_translated: 受控自我演化在自主投资中的应用：一种具有不变核心的多智能体LLM系统
summary_translated: 能够在实时网络数据上行动的大语言模型（LLM）智能体必须整合异构证据，记住过往行为，并根据结果改进自身，同时不削弱自身的安全机制。我们在此问题上研究自主投资场景，其中每项操作不可逆且基于不可信的网络内容。我们提出Steward，一种多智能体LLM系统，通过类型系统划定自我演化的边界。首先，九个角色专精的智能体协同决策：四个分析师分别阅读新闻源、SEC文件、宏观经济数据和市场数据，生成带类型的报告，由投资组合经理设定目标仓位，再由受保护的风险经理进行审计。其次，一个七层共享记忆系统，由系统自身记录代码组装而成，为每个决策提供位置上下文、市场叙事、校准信息及智能体过往决策。第三，系统通过评审实现自我改进：代码每日对每笔交易和预测进行评分并写入记忆，每季度由反思者提出提示学习，经确定性门控可逆执行，通过回放记录输入进行验证。三者均围绕一个不变核心运行——顺序算术、风险规则和纪律性智能体提示，任何自我编辑都无法触及。在为期五个月的线上部署（102个交易日，1632次LLM调用）中，系统在24.6%行业下跌中仅亏损0.3%；在回放其记录输入时，单一模型在相同原始数据下五天内交易更多且亏损1.35点，而联合设计则无显著损失，且未执行任何注入指令；2015-2026年的回测显示，仅核心部分即在所有50种随机入场策略下降低最大回撤。反思者追溯到主要失败的根本原因，门控在触发晚间应用了学习，且在无控制晚间未执行。代码：https://github.com/yebof/quant-agent。

summary: In large language model (LLM) steganography, an encoder hides a private message in an otherwise ordinary response, as text transmitted to a decoder, who attempts to recover it. The success of this private-message transmission is commonly measured through end-to-end (E2E) recovery, which checks whether the decoder correctly reconstructs the private message. However, E2E recovery cannot distinguish encoding failures from decoding failures or reveal how the private message is represented in the encoder's transmitted text. To address these limitations, we introduce a rolewise decomposition framework that separately examines how private messages are represented in encoder transmitted texts, what decoders recover, and what deterministic verification can establish. Across 7,200 encoder responses, we identify 168 verifiable encodings missed by decoders and 706 responses containing private messages reconstructed through word-length or token-initial patterns not explicitly specified in the encoder's instructions. These findings demonstrate that E2E recovery alone may obscure important distinctions between encoding and decoding, motivating their separate evaluation to better understand and mitigate the safety issues caused by LLM steganography.
title: Beyond End-to-End Recovery: Towards a Better Understanding of LLM Steganography via Rolewise Decomposition
title_translated: 超越端到端恢复：通过角色分解深入理解大语言模型隐写术
summary_translated: 在大语言模型（LLM）隐写术中，编码器将私密信息隐藏在看似普通的响应文本中并传输给解码器，解码器尝试从中恢复该信息。通常通过端到端（E2E）恢复来衡量私密信息传输的成功率，但E2E恢复无法区分编码失败与解码失败，也无法揭示私密信息在编码器传输文本中的具体表示方式。为解决这些局限性，我们提出一种角色分解框架，分别分析私密信息在编码器输出文本中的表示、解码器实际恢复的内容以及确定性验证所能确认的信息。通过对7200个编码器响应的分析，我们发现了168个被解码器遗漏的可验证编码，以及706个通过词长或标记首字母模式重建私密信息的响应，而这些模式并未在编码器指令中明确说明。这些发现表明，仅依赖E2E恢复可能掩盖编码与解码之间的关键差异，因此有必要对两者进行独立评估，以更好地理解并缓解LLM隐写术带来的安全问题。

summary: Personal intelligence systems are taking on increasingly complex everyday tasks, yet repeated questions, unnecessary confirmations, and unwanted outreach can turn capable assistance into interaction burden. Reducing this burden requires agents to remember how users want to be assisted. However, existing memory benchmarks focus on factual recall and personalized answers and rarely test how agents learn and act on interaction preferences. We introduce MemPABench, an interactive environment for on-policy evaluation of memory in personal agents. MemPABench poses long-horizon tasks requiring agents to decide when to clarify, confirm, or act autonomously. Four grounded simulated users hold 14 preferences across work and personal contexts. Their feedback spans 99 sessions over four months, with five event-driven changes per user testing memory updates. We evaluate preference selection, delivered behavior, and sensitivity to context and preference change. Evaluating four memory systems across four LLM backbones, we find that current memory brings limited gains in preference selection. Retrieval-based systems (i.e. Mem0, MemOS, simple RAG) do not outperform No Memory, while File-based memory improves accuracy but applies preferences beyond relevant contexts. Our analysis shows that current memory struggles to retrieve interaction preferences and adapt to preference changes. Even with the correct preference available, overriding the agent's default interaction habits remains challenging. The environment and dataset are available at https://mempabench.com.
title: Why Bother Me Again? Benchmarking Personal Agent Memory for Interaction Preferences

title_translated: 为何反复打扰我？面向交互偏好的个人智能体记忆基准测试
summary_translated: 个人智能系统正承担日益复杂的日常任务，但重复提问、不必要的确认和不请自来的互动会将高效辅助转变为交互负担。减轻这种负担需要智能体记住用户希望如何被协助。然而，现有的记忆基准主要关注事实回忆和个性化回答，很少测试智能体如何学习并执行交互偏好。为此，我们提出了MemPABench，一个用于个人智能体记忆在策略内评估的交互式环境。MemPABench设计了长周期任务，要求智能体决定何时澄清、确认或自主行动。四个基于真实场景的模拟用户在工作和个人情境中拥有14种偏好，其反馈覆盖99次会话长达四个月，并包含每位用户五次由事件触发的偏好变更以测试记忆更新能力。我们评估了偏好选择、行为表现以及对上下文和偏好变化的敏感性。在四种LLM骨干网络上评估四种记忆系统后发现，当前记忆在偏好选择方面带来的提升有限。基于检索的记忆系统（如Mem0、MemOS、简单RAG）并未优于无记忆情况，而基于文件的记忆系统虽提高了准确性，却常将偏好应用到无关上下文中。分析表明，当前记忆难以有效检索交互偏好并适应偏好变化。即使正确偏好可用，智能体仍难以克服默认交互习惯。相关环境与数据集已公开于https://mempabench.com。

summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) were originally motivated by discovering monosemantic features, a property that characterizes individual features but does not specify what the learned feature set should look like as a whole. As SAEs have increasingly been adopted for attribution, circuit discovery, and intervention, researchers have begun evaluating metrics that describe global properties of the feature set, such as sparsity, dead feature rates, reconstruction fidelity, and disentanglement, a diverse set that extends far beyond monosemanticity. However, this implicit shift beyond monosemanticity has not been formalized as a clear, well-defined objective that comes before these evaluation metrics. Without such an objective, existing metrics remain ad hoc, with their necessity unjustified. In this work, we formalize this ultimate objective by introducing a new paradigm for SAE evaluation: requiring that SAE features, and more generally dictionary-based decompositions of model representations, form an atomic interpretable unit basis, a coordinate system for semantically meaningful explanation. Under this paradigm, we organize existing and new measurements such as DAME (Dominance-Aware Monosemanticity Evaluation) as proxy metrics and introduce a comprehensive benchmarking framework. Evaluating hundreds of SAEs across multiple architectures and model families, we uncover failure modes in which some SAEs appear monosemantic under existing evaluation metrics while remaining functionally polysemantic: the most dominant features, those contributing most to model computation, are systematically less interpretable and more redundant. These failure modes warrant attention from SAE researchers as targets for improved training and architectures, and motivate dominance-aware evaluation as a standard check for practitioners before SAE features are deployed for attribution, circuit tracing, or intervention.
title: Rethinking SAE Evaluation: An Atomic Interpretable Unit Framework Reveals Hidden Polysemanticity and Redundancy

title_translated: 重新思考SAE评估：原子可解释单元框架揭示隐藏的多义性与冗余性
summary_translated: 稀疏自编码器（SAEs）最初旨在发现单义特征，这一特性描述了单个特征的性质，但并未规定整个特征集应有的整体形态。随着SAEs越来越多地应用于归因分析、电路发现和干预研究，研究人员开始采用描述特征集全局属性的评估指标，如稀疏性、死特征率、重建保真度和解耦程度，这些指标种类繁多，远超单义性范畴。然而，这种从单义性向更广泛目标的隐性转变尚未被形式化为一个清晰、明确的先验目标，导致现有评估指标缺乏理论根基，其必要性难以自洽。本文通过引入SAE评估的新范式，正式确立这一终极目标：要求SAE特征及更广泛的模型表示字典分解形成原子可解释单元基，即语义可解释的坐标系。在此范式下，我们将DAME（主导感知单义性评估）等现有与新测量方法作为代理指标，并构建全面的基准测试框架。在多个架构和模型家族中评估数百个SAE后，我们发现某些SAE在现有评估指标下看似单义，实则功能上具有多义性：最主导的特征——对模型计算贡献最大的部分——反而系统性地更难解释且更具冗余性。这些失效模式值得SAE研究者关注，应成为改进训练方法与模型架构的目标；同时，也推动在部署SAE用于归因、电路追踪或干预前，将其纳入主导感知评估作为标准检查。

summary: Modern LLM agents can retrieve information from accessible documents, and then disclose a sensitive conclusion assembled from them. This mosaic effect creates a critical risk for agents operating over confidential data. We quantify its realization with 30 synthetic cybersecurity, medical, and military examples, yielding 10,800 final answers from three LLM agents in controlled simulation and 1,440 answers from live agents in two open-source harnesses. Even under benign queries designed to be answerable from one document, GPT-5.6-Sol, the best performing model tested, discloses forbidden composites in 7.08% of answers (95% CI: 3.75-10.67%) in simulation, with worse disclosure rates in live harnesses. Adding visible classification headers and explicit aggregation rules reduces pooled disclosure rates substantially, yet unsafe disclosures persist in 32.37% of simulated answers (95% CI: 28.33-36.19%) across all intents despite these safeguards. Furthermore, increased refusals do not guarantee confidentiality, since significant refusals reveal the prohibited conclusion regardless. These results point to a troubling conclusion: sensitive data leaks via mosaic-style events are an observed confidentiality failure mode in the evaluated settings at non-negligible rates. They motivate stronger controls on what agents may infer and disclose in sensitive data environments with mixed-clearance users.
title: Agent Mosaic: Recognizing Confidentiality Leaks in Agentic LLM Systems

title_translated: 智能体拼图：识别代理型LLM系统中的保密泄露
summary_translated: 现代LLM智能体能够从可访问文档中检索信息，并据此披露由这些信息拼合而成的敏感结论。这种‘拼图效应’在处理机密数据的智能体中构成重大风险。我们通过30个合成的网络安全、医疗和军事案例量化了该现象的实现，生成了三名LLM智能体在受控模拟中的10,800条最终答案，以及两个开源测试平台中活体智能体的1,440条回答。即使在设计为仅需单一文档即可回答的良性查询下，性能最佳的GPT-5.6-Sol模型在模拟中仍有7.08%的回答（95%置信区间：3.75%-10.67%）披露了禁止组合内容，而在活体测试平台中披露率更高。增加可见分类标题和明确聚合规则虽显著降低了合并披露率，但在所有意图下，模拟答案中仍有32.37%（95%置信区间：28.33%-36.19%）存在不安全披露，即便有这些防护措施。此外，更高的拒绝率并不保证保密性，因为大量拒绝本身就会暴露被禁止的结论。这些结果表明，在所评估环境中，通过拼图式事件引发的敏感数据泄露已成为可观测的保密失效模式。这促使我们在混合权限用户的数据环境中，加强对智能体推理与披露行为的更强控制。

summary: Social media platforms provide spaces for individuals to disclose mental health experiences and seek support, yet how these disclosures evolve during major shifts in platform governance remains unclear. We examine mental health self-disclosure surrounding Elon Musk's October 2022 acquisition of Twitter, analyzing approximately 824K tweets across anxiety, depression, bipolar disorder (BD), borderline personality disorder (BPD), and suicidal ideation (SI) or related experiences, alongside 266K comparison tweets. Using Linguistic Inquiry and Word Count (LIWC) and an LLM-based intimacy classifier, we characterize changes in psycholinguistic expression and disclosure intimacy. Following the acquisition, we observe declines in affective and social language, alongside increases in first-person singular pronouns and future-focused expressions. Intimacy patterns vary by condition: anxiety, depression, and BPD show increases in low-intimacy and decreases in moderate-intimacy disclosures, whereas suicide-related posts show more high-intimacy disclosures. However, compared with broader Twitter discourse, only the relative decline in moderate- versus low-intimacy disclosure for BPD remains statistically significant. Our findings underscore the importance of considering both language and intimacy when studying platform transitions, informing the design of online environments that support sensitive self-disclosure.
title: X-pressing Intimacy: Mental Health Disclosure After Twitter Acquisition
title_translated: X-pressing亲密：推特收购后的心理健康披露
summary_translated: 社交媒体平台为个体提供披露心理健康经历并寻求支持的空间，但平台治理发生重大变革时，此类披露如何演变仍不明确。我们研究了埃隆·马斯克2022年10月收购推特前后，关于焦虑、抑郁、双相情感障碍（BD）、边缘型人格障碍（BPD）以及自杀意念（SI）或相关体验的心理健康自我披露，分析了约82.4万条推文及26.6万条对照推文。利用语言询问与词频分析（LIWC）和基于LLM的亲密性分类器，我们刻画了心理语言表达和披露亲密性的变化。收购后，我们观察到情感与社交语言减少，第一人称单数代词和未来导向表达增加。不同心理状况下的亲密性模式各异：焦虑、抑郁和BPD患者的低亲密性披露增加，中等亲密性披露减少；而与自杀相关的帖子则表现出更多高亲密性披露。然而，相较于更广泛的推特话语，只有BPD患者中中等与低亲密性披露的相对下降具有统计显著性。我们的研究强调，在分析平台变迁时，必须同时考虑语言特征与亲密性维度，为设计支持敏感自我披露的在线环境提供依据。

summary: LLM correctors of ASR output are judged by aggregate WER, which hides what they fix and what they break. We decompose every WER change exactly into repaired tokens, damaged tokens and insertions, and use this to ask what the source audio adds to a corrector. We compare correction with and without the audio, for the model's own draft and for the output of an independent recogniser, on three corpora. With Gemini 2.5 Flash, text-only correction of its own draft breaks 13-32% of already-correct transcripts; with the audio, 1-3%. Damage falls in both settings. Repair falls against the own draft and rises against the recogniser. On medical dictation, kept insertions cancel the gain in net WER. The open-weight Voxtral, which rarely edits, does not show this pattern. Prompts differ between the two arms, so the contrasts bound the effect of the audio and do not isolate it.
title: Text-Only LLM Correctors Break Correct Transcripts: A Repair-Damage Analysis of Audio Grounding in ASR Error Correction
title_translated: 仅文本的LLM校正器会破坏正确转录：语音对齐在ASR错误纠正中的修复与损伤分析
summary_translated: ASR输出的LLM校正器通常以整体WER（词错误率）来评估，但这掩盖了它们修复和破坏的内容。我们精确地将每个WER变化分解为修复的词元、受损的词元和插入项，并利用这一分解来探究源音频对校正器的作用。我们在三个语料库上比较了有无音频条件下的校正效果，分别针对模型自身的草稿和独立识别器的输出。使用Gemini 2.5 Flash时，仅基于文本对自身草稿进行校正会破坏13%-32%原本正确的转录；而加入音频后，损坏比例降至1%-3%。在两种情况下，损伤均下降；但针对自身草稿时修复效果下降，而针对识别器输出时修复效果上升。在医疗语音记录中，保留的插入项抵消了净WER的改善。开放权重的Voxtral模型很少修改内容，未表现出此模式。由于两组提示存在差异，因此对比结果界定了音频的影响范围，但无法完全隔离其作用。

summary: Activation probes are computed directions in a language model's residual stream, used both to detect safety-relevant behaviours and, by adding their direction back into the stream, to steer them. We explore how the main design choices behind such probes interact, within one pipeline, on one model (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct), and across three behaviours: deception, high-stakes awareness and sycophancy. The pipeline crosses two estimators (difference-of-means and logistic regression) with three token-pooling schemes (last, mean and learned attention), selects appropriate layers to detect or steer a behaviour, and evaluates every direction twice: as a detector of the behaviour, and as a steering vector to push outputs towards the behaviour. Prior work read together suggests a read/write dissociation, in which logistic regression reads (detects) best but difference-of-means directions write (steer) best. We find that it holds for deception and high-stakes but not for sycophancy, where the pattern reverses. The reversal appears to follow partially from the data rather than from the estimators. The best pooling technique and the layer choice depend on the behaviour and data, and the layer that steers best can sit well before the layer that detects best. The right steering metric to use between changing a model's perception and eliciting behaviour depends on the task - and the two can disagree outright. The exported probes and directions power an interactive interface through which a user can score and steer text directly.
title: Probing and Steering for Safety-Relevant Behaviours in Large Language Models

title_translated: 探测与引导大型语言模型中的安全相关行为
summary_translated: 激活探测是语言模型残差流中的方向向量，既可用于检测安全相关行为，也可通过将该方向重新注入流中来引导行为。我们在一个模型（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct）上系统研究了此类探测器设计选择之间的相互作用，涵盖三种行为：欺骗、高风险意识和阿谀奉承。该流程结合两种估计器（均值差与逻辑回归）与三种词元池化策略（最后、平均、学习注意力），选择合适的层用于检测或引导特定行为，并对每种方向进行两次评估：作为行为检测器，以及作为推动输出朝向该行为的引导向量。先前研究暗示存在读写分离现象——即逻辑回归在读取（检测）方面表现最佳，而均值差方向在写入（引导）方面最优。我们发现该现象适用于欺骗和高风险行为，但不适用于阿谀奉承行为，后者呈现出相反趋势。这种反转部分源于数据而非估计器本身。最佳池化方法和层选择取决于具体行为与数据，且最佳引导层可能位于最佳检测层之前。在改变模型感知与诱发行为之间，应使用何种引导度量取决于任务——两者甚至可能完全冲突。所导出的探测与方向支持一个交互式界面，用户可直接评分并引导文本生成。

summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems face security, privacy, and copyright risks including content leakage, source reconstruction, unauthorized access, data poisoning, and prompt injection. Yet RAG protection studies use incompatible evaluation metrics, datasets, and threat models. We present a systematic survey and human-coded evidence map of 118 full-text-confirmed RAG defense papers, organized by measured endpoint rather than claimed goal or defense mechanism. Our seven-family taxonomy covers content disclosure, formal privacy proxies, access control and suppression, corpus-use detection, and pipeline integrity and attribution. Thirty-two annotators double-coded the papers kappa=0.867. The survey identifies three gaps. First, retrieval reranking and context rewriting each span five or six endpoint families, so mechanisms do not identify protection outcomes. Second, only 17.8% of studies use content disclosure or reconstruction as their primary endpoint; under the frozen copyright/ownership relation label, 73.3% of records have corpus-use detection as their primary endpoint, and none have an emitted-expression primary endpoint. Third, most evaluations use general-purpose question-answering datasets and non-adaptive attacks rather than sensitive data and adaptive, multi-turn extraction. Our controlled RAG testbed shows that preventing verbatim copying does not prevent private-fact recovery: a normalized 8-gram guard reduces 20-token copying to 0.0%, but a three-query adaptive attacker recovers 48.3% of hidden facts on Qwen3-8B. We release the taxonomy, dataset, coding protocols, and testbed to enable comparable, claim-aligned RAG security evaluation.
title: Protection Is Not One Event: A Survey of RAG Protection Research by Measured Endpoint

title_translated: 保护并非单一事件：基于测量端点的RAG防护研究综述
summary_translated: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统面临包括内容泄露、来源重构、未经授权访问、数据投毒和提示注入在内的安全、隐私与版权风险。然而，现有RAG防护研究采用不兼容的评估指标、数据集与威胁模型。本文对118篇经全文确认的RAG防御论文进行了系统性综述与人工编码证据图谱，按测量端点而非声称目标或防御机制进行组织。我们的七类分类体系涵盖内容披露、形式化隐私代理、访问控制与抑制、语料使用检测，以及流水线完整性和归属。32名标注者双盲标注，Kappa值达0.867。综述揭示三大缺口：第一，重排序与上下文重写各自覆盖五至六个端点家族，表明机制无法明确对应保护结果；第二，仅有17.8%的研究以内容披露或重构为主要端点；在“冻结版权/所有权”标签下，73.3%的记录以语料使用检测为主，无一项以生成表达为主；第三，多数评估使用通用问答数据集和非自适应攻击，而非敏感数据与自适应、多轮提取攻击。我们构建的受控RAG测试平台显示，防止逐字复制并不能阻止私有事实恢复：一个归一化的8-gram防护机制将20词复制降至0.0%，但三轮自适应攻击者仍能恢复Qwen3-8B模型中48.3%的隐藏事实。我们公开发布分类体系、数据集、编码协议与测试平台，以推动可比、主张一致的RAG安全评估。

summary: A segmentation policy assigns to each byte string at most one segmentation into tokens. Call it finitely verifiable when a finite automaton over marked strings, bytes paired with boundary bits, accepts exactly the policy's own segmentations. The automaton judges a proposed segmentation and need not compute one. The paper shows what that hypothesis buys. Four questions that practice settles by folklore become decidable, whether a window certifies a token boundary, whether the boundary gap is bounded, whether a mask keeps generation completable, and whether two policies are equivalent. The last three specialize limitedness, coaccessibility and the equivalence of single-valued transducers. The first refines the synchronizing cut of code theory, and two more ask whether a certified cut, or the cuts of an inventory, let each piece scan alone. The class sits strictly between the online-scannable policies and those with regular domains, and its inner frontier is Choffrut's and decidable in polynomial time. Markings are length-preserving, so the class is exactly the rational segmentation policies, a normal form rather than a restriction, and what the decisions need is a supplied verifier. The class is closed under the operations pipelines use: composition over a labeled stage, restriction, splitting, and byte-fallback union of literal policies. Each composite inherits the six decisions, and certificates transfer between stages under four laws. Under rational, unifilar, almost surely stopping finite-state sources, each mass of the weighted section is an exact rational, and so is each rate where expected length is positive. Maximal-munch lexing, canonical byte-pair encoding and two-mode WordPiece instantiate the interface, and the munch library implements all six decisions. Every theorem carries an executable check, and every reported statistic is a program's own output.
title: Finitely Verifiable Segmentation: Decidability for Every Tokenizer with a Finite-State Verifier

title_translated: 有限可验证分段：每种分词器对应的有限状态验证器的可判定性
summary_translated: 分段策略将每个字节串最多分配一种分词结果。若存在一个有限自动机，作用于标记字符串（字节与边界位配对），恰好接受该策略的所有分段，则称该策略为有限可验证。该自动机仅需判断一个提议的分段是否有效，无需自行计算分段。本文探讨该假设带来的理论收益。四个实践中依赖经验判断的问题变为可判定问题：窗口能否证明词边界？边界间隙是否有限？掩码是否保证生成可完成？两个分段策略是否等价？后三个问题分别对应有限性、共可达性及单值转换器等价性。第一个问题细化了代码理论中的同步切割概念，另两个则询问：认证切割或库存切割是否允许每一段独立扫描。该类严格介于在线可扫描策略与具有正规域的策略之间，其内部边界由Choffrut确定，且可在多项式时间内判定。标记保持长度不变，因此该类恰好等于有理分段策略，是一种标准形式而非限制，其决策依赖于提供的验证器。该类在流水线常用操作下封闭：标签阶段上的复合、限制、拆分，以及字节回退的字面策略并集。每个复合结构继承六项判定能力，且证书在四条法则下可在阶段间传递。在有理、无歧义、几乎必然停止的有限状态源下，加权部分的质量为精确有理数，且期望长度为正时的速率亦为有理数。最大贪心词法、标准字节对编码及双模式WordPiece均实例化该接口，munch库实现了全部六项判定。每条定理均可执行验证，所有报告统计数据均为程序自身输出。

summary: Decision models return normalized probability distributions over candidate choices, which downstream applications can use to select among choices. Although their providers emphasize the reliability of these probabilities, calibration on tasks with a single correct choice does not establish their reliability when multiple choices are correct. We evaluate three decision models (Jev, Liquid d1, and GPT-6 Luna Decisions) on three diverse datasets (MetaTool, HotpotQA, and ECtHR) to study probability allocation and thresholding. Even when models rank every correct choice above every distractor, in 28% to 50% of those lists, at least one correct choice receives a probability below the uniform probability of 1/n, where n is the number of choices. We also present each model with five identical copies of a correct choice and observe probability disparities, with mean gaps ranging from 17 to 79 percentage points. We further show how these allocation disparities affect the recovery of multiple correct choices under probability thresholding. Decision-model probabilities can rank correct choices, but a probability threshold does not identify the set of correct choices.
title: When Multiple Choices Are Correct: Asymmetric Probability Allocation in Jev and Other Decision Models
